english: A fresh ladder is drawn up each term. Only completed matches count towards ladder points.
chinese: 只有打完的比賽才計入排名賽積分。每學期均會重新編製排名表。

english: Put damp papers in the general waste bin. Line the collection box with a paper bag.
chinese: 請在收集箱內鋪上紙袋。濕報紙請投放到一般垃圾桶。

english: Print the correction on the last page of the next issue. The archive keeps the original issue available.
chinese: 資料庫仍可供查閱原有期刊。更正啟事須刊於下一期的首頁。

english: The donor arranges delivery to the community room. The piano will be tuned after it arrives.
chinese: 社區活動室管理員須安排到捐贈者處收取鋼琴。鋼琴送抵後會安排調音。

english: You can transfer your repair appointment to another household member.
chinese: 你可把維修預約轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。

english: Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments. Spelling corrections can be added in the shared document.
chinese: 可在共用文件加入拼寫更正。傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前，須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。

english: Members may write directly in the loan copy. Please mark the chapter you want to discuss.
chinese: 請標示你希望討論的章節。會員可在借閱本貼上可移除的便條。

english: Leave enough space for the inspector to reach the shutoff valve. A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand.
chinese: 如有單位未能接受檢查，只須為該單位另作安排，其他單位的預約維持原定時間。請預留足夠空間，方便檢查人員接觸截流閥。

english: State whether the nutrition figures are for the product as sold or as prepared. Use a legible type size throughout the panel.
chinese: 整個標籤須使用易於閱讀的字體大小。

english: The inventory carries the case number. The officer receiving the property signs the inventory.
chinese: 物品清單由接收遺物的人員簽署。物品清單載有個案編號。

english: Place the insert inside the larger carton. Remove the adhesive strip before folding the insert.
chinese: 摺疊內襯前，請先移除黏貼帶。請把內襯放入較大的紙箱內。

english: The loan slip shows the temporary access period. Notify the management office if the remote stops working. Only the registered resident may collect the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may return it.
chinese: 如遙控器失靈，請通知管理處。借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶領取，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可歸還。借用單列明臨時通行的期限。

english: Notify the management office if the remote stops working. Only the registered resident may collect the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may return it.
chinese: 借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶領取，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可歸還。如遙控器失靈，請通知管理處。

english: Make sure the punched holes align with the spacer. Use the 12 mm screw to join the binder covers.
chinese: 請用12毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。請確保打好的孔與墊片對齊。

english: Attach the brace to the rear leg.
chinese: 請將支撐桿接到後腳。

english: The old line can be taken to the estate recycling point. Attach the white tag to the new clothesline.
chinese: 請在新晾衣繩掛上白色標籤。舊晾衣繩可送往屋苑回收點。

english: Check your name on the proof circulated by your class teacher. Students may use their preferred first name in the yearbook.
chinese: 班主任派發校樣後，請核對你的姓名。學生可在畢業紀念冊使用自己選用的名字。

english: The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition, except during a live demonstration. Each group collects its badges together at the start of the tour.
chinese: 各組別須在導賞開始時一同領取臨時證。臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地，但現場示範期間除外。

english: The receiving institution keeps its own copy of the form. A student may preview the factual information on a reference form, but the teacher's comments remain confidential.
chinese: 學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料，但教師評語仍屬保密。接收院校會自行存檔。

english: Set the music stand on a level surface before working on it. Attach the brace to the rear leg.
chinese: 請將支撐桿接到後腳。操作前請把譜架放在平坦表面。

english: Slides will be shared separately by the presenter. The attendance system keeps a separate list for each session. An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available.
chinese: 考勤系統會分別保存每節活動的出席名單。退出發布的選擇只適用於影片，文字記錄仍可供查閱。講者會另行分享投影片。

english: Wrap each donated violin bow separately. Check that the donation slip gives the donor's contact details.
chinese: 請核對捐贈單是否載有捐贈者的聯絡資料。捐贈的小提琴弓須綑成一束包裹。

english: Name the recording after the reading passage. Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio.
chinese: 每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。請以朗讀篇章的名稱為錄音檔案命名。

english: Orient the printed arrows towards the top opening. Remove the adhesive strip before folding the insert.
chinese: 摺疊內襯前，請先移除黏貼帶。請將印上的箭嘴指向頂部開口。

english: The inspection team will phone the tenant before visiting. There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection.
chinese: 首次申請渠務檢查毋須繳費。檢查人員上門前會致電租戶。

english: Use the 16 mm screw to join the binder covers. Keep the bag of spare fixings in the cover pocket.
chinese: 請用12毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。請把備用配件放在封面內袋。

english: The donor arranges delivery to the community room.
chinese: 捐贈者須安排把鋼琴送至社區活動室。

english: The update form asks for a brief description of the proposed change. We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it. The map editor checks for duplicate locations.
chinese: 地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認，便可更改。地圖編輯人員會檢查是否有重複地點。更新表要求簡述擬作的改動。

english: State whether the nutrition figures are for the product as sold or as prepared. Display the ingredient list next to the nutrition panel.
chinese: 成分表須列於營養標籤旁。須列明營養數值是按出售時還是調配後的產品計算。

english: Original files remain in the restricted research folder. Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed. Club members can flag duplicate images for the editor.
chinese: 只有在刪除坐標後，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。學會會員可標記重複相片，供編輯處理。原始檔案會保留在限制存取的研究資料夾。

english: A volunteer keeps a list of the contributions received. The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group.
chinese: 故事分享小組保留錄音只供內部謄寫，並會向小組成員分享經編輯的文字稿。義工會備存已收到的分享內容清單。

english: Use the side door to reach the waiting area. You can transfer your repair appointment to another household member.
chinese: 請經側門前往等候區。你可把維修預約轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。

english: Show the inspection booking confirmation on arrival. Visitors may take handwritten notes during inspection.
chinese: 查閱登記冊時，訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。抵達後請出示查閱預約確認。

english: Assign the left pedal to page forward. Check the pedal's action in the test document.
chinese: 請在測試文件中檢查踏板功能。請將左踏板設定為翻至上一頁。

english: Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments. The host will send the final transcript to the guest.
chinese: 傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前，須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。主持人會把最終文字稿交給嘉賓。

english: A written confirmation will be issued for each approved retake. If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake.
chinese: 如監考員缺席，只有未能開始應考的學生可申請重考。重考申請獲批後，考生會收到書面確認。

english: Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter. Please keep the space around the counter clear.
chinese: 請勿阻塞櫃檯一帶。

english: The loan slip shows the temporary access period. Only the registered resident may collect the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may return it. The guard will enter the remote's number in the issue log.
chinese: 借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶歸還，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可領取。保安員會在借出紀錄簿填寫遙控器編號。借用單列明臨時通行的期限。

english: The desk volunteer checks the voucher record before confirming eligibility. Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed.
chinese: 櫃檯義工會先查閱券的紀錄，再確認資格。藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用藍色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。

english: Assign the left pedal to page back. Keep the configuration window open until the test ends.
chinese: 測試完結前，請保持設定視窗開啟。請將左踏板設定為翻至下一頁。

english: Set the keyboard to the acoustic piano sound for the practical assessment. The examiner will provide a foot pedal.
chinese: 實習評核須把電子琴設定為原聲鋼琴音色。考官會提供腳踏板。

english: Record the date on which the original transcript was shared. The case reference appears at the top of each record.
chinese: 請記錄發出原有文字記錄的日期。每份紀錄的頂部均載有個案編號。如來電者對通話文字記錄有異議，須將來電者提交的書面更正與原文一併保存。

english: Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file. Each submission is assigned a project reference. Senders may request confirmation of receipt.
chinese: 附交的插圖須退回寄件人，隨附函件則留在項目檔案。每份呈交的文件均獲編配項目參考編號。寄件人可要求確認收件。

english: The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, except for participants already assigned a shuttle. Keep the event organiser's telephone number with you.
chinese: 請隨身備存活動主辦人的電話號碼。如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者除外。

english: Line the collection box with a paper bag. Put damp papers in the general waste bin.
chinese: 濕報紙請投放到一般垃圾桶。請在收集箱內鋪上紙袋。

english: Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place. Keep removed clips in the storage pouch. The installation sheet has a diagram of the clip locations.
chinese: 已拆除的夾具須放入收納袋。安裝說明附有夾具位置圖。安裝後只須拆除固定可拆式層板的運輸固定夾。

english: Mark the approximate position on the harbour chart. Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen.
chinese: 請在海圖上標示大概位置。請記錄首次發現油膜的時間。

english: Enter the water after the second whistle. Tell the coach if you need to leave the session early.
chinese: 第二下哨聲響起後方可下水。如須提早離場，請通知教練。

english: The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section B of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting. Keep the instrument cover with the drum itself. The receptionist confirms which items have been returned.
chinese: 清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊B欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。鼓罩須與鼓一同存放。接待員會確認已交還的物品。

english: The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days. Return unused strands in the original sleeve.
chinese: 未用完的紗線須放回原有封套交還。紗線樣本可免費借用十四天。

english: Attach the blue tag to the new clothesline. Please avoid hanging wet items over the footpath.
chinese: 請在新晾衣繩掛上白色標籤。請勿把濕衣物晾掛在行人徑上方。

english: The secretary will confirm any change of address before updating the register. The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, provided that both renew together. New members receive their own membership number.
chinese: 秘書會先確認地址變更，再更新會員名冊。同住的兄弟姊妹如一同續會，社團可豁免第二人的會費。新會員各有獨立會員編號。

english: The boundary is marked with low timber posts. The lawn can reopen after seeding, except in the marked section beside the shelter. The grounds team will inspect seed growth each week.
chinese: 草地完成播種後可重開，但涼亭旁有標記的部分除外。園務小組會每周檢查種子生長情況。邊界設有矮木柱作標記。

english: Use the prop's asset number on the inspection form. Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session.
chinese: 請在檢查表填寫道具的資產編號。每次保養後，須記錄潤滑劑的批次編號。

english: The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, except for participants already assigned a shuttle. A final route note will be shared before the event.
chinese: 如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者除外。活動前會發出最終路線通知。

english: Notify the management office if the remote stops working. Only the registered resident may collect the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may return it. The loan slip shows the temporary access period.
chinese: 如遙控器失靈，請通知管理處。借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶領取，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可歸還。借用單列明臨時通行的期限。

english: The officer receiving the property signs the inventory.
chinese: 物品清單由接收遺物的人員簽署。

english: Return serviceable road studs to stores only after the inspection team signs the recovery sheet. Record the location of each recovered item. Scrap metal goes into a separate container.
chinese: 狀況良好的路面反光標只能在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄後送回物料倉。請記錄每件回收物品的位置。廢金屬須放入另一容器。

english: The master worksheet remains unchanged by the export. Export all verified rows, and suppress the notes column for rows with personal data. Use the preview to verify each row number.
chinese: 匯出資料不會改動主工作表。須匯出所有已核實的資料列，但包含個人資料的資料列不輸出備註欄內容。請在預覽中核對每個資料列編號。

english: The photographic record is attached to the maintenance report. Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath above it.
chinese: 相片紀錄將附於保養報告。請從擋土牆上方的行人徑拍攝牆身。

english: Use the sterile glass bottle supplied with the sampling kit. Keep the filled bottle cool during transport.
chinese: 裝妥樣本後，運送時須保持樣本瓶低溫。請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。

english: Remove the objective without touching the glass. The checkout log tracks which magnification is in use. If the storage sleeve feels damp, replace the sleeve before putting the objective away.
chinese: 借用紀錄列明正在使用的放大倍率。如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。取出物鏡時請勿觸碰鏡片。

english: Keep any redeemed voucher number for your records. Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed.
chinese: 請自行保存已兌換的券號。藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用藍色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。

english: The handle locks into place at its lowest setting. Push the latch inward to lower the trolley handle.
chinese: 向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。手柄調至最低位置時會鎖定。

english: Leave the sketch to dry before putting it in a sleeve. Apply one light coat to the practice sketch.
chinese: 素描乾透後才可放入保護套。請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。

english: State whether the nutrition figures are for the product as sold or as prepared. The declared serving size should be clearly visible.
chinese: 須列明營養數值是按出售時還是調配後的產品計算。標示的食用分量應清楚顯示。

english: The register records the role attached to each token. The system sends a confirmation when a token is deactivated. When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate their lead-guide token immediately and retain any observer token until the end of the current tour. Existing route bookings remain available to the replacement guide.
chinese: 登記冊列明每個通行憑證所對應的身分。通行憑證停用後，系統會發出確認通知。導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊通行憑證；觀察員通行憑證則保留至該次導賞完結。接任導賞員仍可使用已預約的路線時段。

english: Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence. You can change your email address after activation.
chinese: 服務啟用後可更改電郵地址。啟用電子函件服務須使用上一期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。

english: You can transfer your repair appointment to another household member. Spare parts are subject to availability.
chinese: 零件供應視乎存貨而定。你可把維修預約轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。

english: Assign the left pedal to page back. Connect the pedal directly to the computer.
chinese: 請將左踏板設定為翻至上一頁。請把踏板直接接駁到電腦。

english: Volunteers empty collection points at the end of the event. Food scraps are sorted at the venue. Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice.
chinese: 活動完結時由義工清空收集點。廚餘須在會場分類。內袋只要有任何可堆肥標誌，便可投放到堆肥收集系統。

english: Use laminated card for the portfolio divider sheets. Keep photographs in removable sleeves.
chinese: 相片須放在可拆式透明套內。作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。

english: Only completed matches count towards ladder points. A fresh ladder is drawn up each term.
chinese: 每學期均會重新編製排名表。未打完的比賽亦計入排名賽積分。

english: Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim. State which project the expenditure relates to.
chinese: 請說明開支所屬的項目。申請發還款項時須提交報價單。

english: Students may use their preferred first name in the yearbook. Class groups are listed separately.
chinese: 各班的名單會分開刊載。學生須在畢業紀念冊使用學籍上登記的名字。

english: The map editor checks for duplicate locations. Please copy the current pin label into your message. We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it.
chinese: 地圖編輯人員會檢查是否有重複地點。請在訊息內抄錄現有地圖標記的標籤。地圖標記須獲場地經理及原提供資料者雙方確認，方可更改。

english: Please keep the badge visible throughout the tour. The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition, except during a live demonstration. Each group collects its badges together at the start of the tour.
chinese: 導賞期間請全程在顯眼處佩戴臨時證。臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地，但現場示範期間除外。各組別須在導賞開始時一同領取臨時證。

english: Replace the humidity card once two squares have turned pink. Wash and dry your hands before handling a new card.
chinese: 濕度指示卡有三格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。觸碰新指示卡前，請洗手並把雙手抹乾。

english: Use the 12 mm screw to join the binder covers. Start the thread by hand before tightening it with the tool.
chinese: 先用手旋入螺絲，再用工具擰緊。請用12毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。

english: In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the first code in the log key. Each cassette should be logged by its title.
chinese: 每盒錄音帶須按其標題登記。紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第一個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: The register must remain in the inspection room. Visitors may take handwritten notes during inspection.
chinese: 登記冊須留在查閱室內。查閱登記冊時，訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。

english: There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection. You can track the request using the case number.
chinese: 首次申請渠務檢查毋須繳費。可憑個案編號查詢進度。

english: Set the right margin to 8 mm before printing the labels. Return unused labels to the storage bag.
chinese: 請將未使用的標籤放回儲存袋。列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為6毫米。

english: For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water after supply has resumed. The call record distinguishes colour complaints from pressure complaints. Urgent safety calls continue to go straight to the response team.
chinese: 水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。來電紀錄會區分水色和水壓投訴。緊急安全求助仍直接轉介應變小組。

english: Pay the jar deposit by bank transfer.
chinese: 玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。

english: Use the same tripod for each exposure. Set the camera to record RAW files for the lighting exercise.
chinese: 進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存RAW檔案。每次曝光須使用同一個三腳架。

english: Pay the jar deposit in cash. You can use your usual member number on the order.
chinese: 玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。訂購時可沿用原有會員編號。

english: Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation. The grant report may include photos of the equipment in use.
chinese: 以資助金購買的器材歸受資助機構所有。資助報告可附上使用器材的相片。

english: The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. For a public demonstration, enable the first profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through. The display technician checks the screen feed before people enter. The image format is the same under both profiles.
chinese: 觀眾入場前，顯示設備技術員會檢查畫面訊號。兩個設定檔所用的影像格式相同。第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。

english: A note should record when the substitute entered the pitch. Captains may inspect the updated register after the match. The tournament secretary flags an unauthorised substitute, and the referee corrects the team sheet.
chinese: 紀錄應註明替補球員上場的時間。賽後隊長可查閱已更新的紀錄。未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。

english: Use the new meter's opening reading as the billing baseline. A technician may ask to see the previous bill.
chinese: 技術員可能要求查閱上一期帳單。請以舊水錶的終結讀數作為計費基準。

english: Insert the artwork with the inked face down. Hold the frame steady until the image transfers.
chinese: 請固定框架，直至圖案轉印完成。放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝下。

english: Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file. Each submission is assigned a project reference.
chinese: 附交的插圖須退回寄件人，隨附函件則留在項目檔案。每份呈交的文件均獲編配項目參考編號。

english: Stand the pole tip-down to dry the lower shaft. Wipe mud from the ferrule after use.
chinese: 使用後請抹去杖頭套的泥污。請將手杖杖尖朝下直立，讓下節杖管風乾。

english: Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review. Number the drafts in chronological order.
chinese: 請按日期先後為各份草稿編號。完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾一個學期。

english: Line the collection box with a plastic bag. The box is emptied by the caretakers.
chinese: 請在收集箱內鋪上紙袋。收集箱由管理員清空。

english: Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter. The workshop ticket includes one drink.
chinese: 工作坊門票包括一杯飲品。

english: Keep teacher comments with the corresponding drafts. Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review.
chinese: 完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾一個學期。教師的評語應與相應的草稿一併保存。

english: Unfinished matches also count towards ladder points. Both players should initial the record sheet.
chinese: 兩名球員均應在賽果紀錄表上簡簽。只有打完的比賽才計入排名賽積分。

english: Volunteers can pick up packing materials from the storeroom. Wrap each donated violin bow separately.
chinese: 義工可到儲物室領取包裝物料。每支捐贈的小提琴弓均須獨立包裹。

english: Record the microchip number shown by the scanner. Entries are linked to the animal's licence file.
chinese: 請記錄由動物主人報稱的晶片號碼。紀錄會與該動物的牌照檔案相連。

english: Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath above it. Record any vegetation obscuring the wall surface.
chinese: 請記錄遮擋牆面的植物。請從擋土牆下方的行人徑拍攝牆身。

english: Entries are linked to the animal's licence file. Record the microchip number shown by the scanner.
chinese: 紀錄會與該動物的牌照檔案相連。請記錄晶片掃描器所顯示的號碼。

english: Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site, but copies may only be released with written permission. General background notes can be downloaded from the consultation page.
chinese: 訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，但須有書面許可方可取得副本。一般背景資料可從諮詢網頁下載。

english: The receiving school will acknowledge delivery by email. Wrap each donated violin bow separately.
chinese: 每支捐贈的小提琴弓均須獨立包裹。接收學校會以電郵確認收貨。

english: Keep the signed form in the works file. Return serviceable road studs to stores only after the inspection team signs the recovery sheet.
chinese: 狀況良好的路面反光標只能在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄後送回物料倉。已簽署的表格須存放於工程檔案。

english: The officer receiving the property signs the inventory. Store the items in a sealed container.
chinese: 遺物須存放於密封容器內。物品清單由接收遺物的人員簽署。

english: Place it where it can be read without moving the stored items. Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink.
chinese: 濕度指示卡有三格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。指示卡應置於毋須移動存放物品便可查看的位置。

english: The case file contains contact and site details. The contractor can request a map for its work crew. If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold the complainant's home address but a site address that identifies only the mural may be retained.
chinese: 承辦商可索取地圖供工作隊使用。如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址，但可保留只用作識別壁畫位置的地址。個案檔案載有聯絡資料及場地資料。

english: Remove the adhesive strip before folding the insert. Orient the printed arrows towards the top opening.
chinese: 請將印上的箭嘴指向頂部開口。摺疊內襯後，請移除黏貼帶。

english: A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area. Record the total number of accepted samples on the batch sheet. Keep the same heat setting while comparing samples.
chinese: 請在批次紀錄表填上獲接納的樣本總數。比較樣本時須維持相同的加熱設定。樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按完好樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。

english: Apply two light coats to the practice sketch. Test the spray pattern on scrap paper.
chinese: 請先在廢紙上試噴，檢查噴霧形狀。請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。

english: The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. When checking the repaired scanner, use the first profile in the test guide for the test scan. Use a blank sheet from the calibration pack for each test.
chinese: 每次測試均須使用校準套件內的空白紙。第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第二個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: Enter the water after the second whistle. The coach will distribute caps at the warm-up area.
chinese: 教練會在熱身區派發泳帽。第一下哨聲響起後方可下水。

english: The lawn can reopen after seeding, except in the marked section beside the shelter. The boundary is marked with low timber posts. The shelter itself remains available.
chinese: 草地完成播種後可重開，但涼亭旁有標記的部分除外。邊界設有矮木柱作標記。涼亭照常開放。

english: The clearance certificate remains valid for six months after issue.
chinese: 合格證明書自簽發日起六個月內有效。

english: The petty cash float is capped at HK$400. The float is counted at the end of each meeting.
chinese: 每次會議完結時須點算備用現金。零用現金備用額上限為港幣400元。

english: The suspension decision is served by registered post. Permit holders can update their correspondence address online.
chinese: 暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。許可證持有人可在網上更新通訊地址。

english: Export all verified rows, and suppress the notes column for rows with personal data. The export file includes a timestamp in its name. The master worksheet remains unchanged by the export.
chinese: 匯出檔案的名稱載有時間戳記。匯出資料不會改動主工作表。只匯出不含個人資料的已核實資料列。

english: If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first. The exhibition covers several periods of local history.
chinese: 學生借出影印本前，須先清除背面的個人筆記。展覽涵蓋本地歷史的不同時期。

english: The digital catalogue uses the same showcase rules. When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work from the showcase but retain anonymous remarks unless the remarks identify them. The showcase includes coursework and written comments.
chinese: 電子圖錄適用相同的展示規則。學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。展覽包含學生習作及書面評語。

english: Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation. Keep a register of the items purchased.
chinese: 請備存購入器材的清冊。以資助金購買的器材歸受資助機構所有。

english: Question scores are entered after each round. The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses.
chinese: 每輪結束後會輸入該輪題目的得分。計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。

english: Tell the coach if you need to leave the session early. Enter the water after the second whistle.
chinese: 如須提早離場，請通知教練。第二下哨聲響起後方可下水。

english: The float is counted at the end of each meeting. The petty cash float is capped at HK$400.
chinese: 零用現金備用額上限為港幣400元。每次會議完結時須點算備用現金。

english: A separate leaflet explains the proposed works. The briefing recording may be released with the speaker's consent.
chinese: 取得講者同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。工程建議另有單張介紹。

english: Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter. Suitable cups are available for participants who need easy-grip handles.
chinese: 如需容易握持的杯柄，可索取合適的杯。

english: Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script. Write the scene number beside each change. Use the shared folder to file the rehearsal notes.
chinese: 請在各項變更旁註明場次。彩排紀錄須存入共用資料夾。須在舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本前修改場務提示表。

english: The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. For a public demonstration, enable the second profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through. The image format is the same under both profiles.
chinese: 第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。兩個設定檔所用的影像格式相同。

english: Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed. The desk volunteer checks the voucher record before confirming eligibility. Keep any redeemed voucher number for your records.
chinese: 櫃檯義工會先查閱券的紀錄，再確認資格。請自行保存已兌換的券號。藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用黃色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。

english: Each member may bring one guest on the walk. The route description includes facilities along the way.
chinese: 路線介紹列出沿途設施。每名會員可攜同一名賓客參加步行導賞。

english: Post each pronunciation recording to the class feed. Name the recording after the reading passage.
chinese: 請以朗讀篇章的名稱為錄音檔案命名。每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。

english: The recording covers the question period. The briefing recording may be released with the speaker's consent.
chinese: 取得講者同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。錄音涵蓋答問環節。

english: Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site, but copies may only be released with written permission. General background notes can be downloaded from the consultation page. Please leave the consultation materials on the reading table after use.
chinese: 一般背景資料可從諮詢網頁下載。用畢請把諮詢資料留在閱覽桌上。訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，亦可毋須書面許可取得副本。

english: Store the pole indoors once dry. Stand the pole tip-down to dry the lower shaft.
chinese: 風乾後請在室內存放手杖。請將手杖杖尖朝下直立，讓下節杖管風乾。

english: General background notes can be downloaded from the consultation page. Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site, but copies may only be released with written permission. Please leave the consultation materials on the reading table after use.
chinese: 訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，但須有書面許可方可取得副本。用畢請把諮詢資料留在閱覽桌上。一般背景資料可從諮詢網頁下載。

english: The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. Use a blank sheet from the calibration pack for each test. When checking the repaired scanner, use the first profile in the test guide for the test scan.
chinese: 每次測試均須使用校準套件內的空白紙。第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第一個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: The receptionist confirms which items have been returned. The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section A of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting. Keep the instrument cover with the drum itself.
chinese: 接待員會確認已交還的物品。清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊B欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。鼓罩須與鼓一同存放。

english: Keep the signed form in the works file. Return serviceable road studs to stores only after the inspection team signs the recovery sheet. Scrap metal goes into a separate container.
chinese: 已簽署的表格須存放於工程檔案。狀況良好的路面反光標只能在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄後送回物料倉。廢金屬須放入另一容器。

english: The doors will open before the introduction. The screening includes audio description.
chinese: 入場門會在開場介紹前開放。放映場次設有口述影像服務。

english: Remove the adhesive strip after folding the insert. Place the insert inside the larger carton.
chinese: 請把內襯放入較大的紙箱內。摺疊內襯前，請先移除黏貼帶。

english: Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts. Racquets can be borrowed from the sports office.
chinese: 選拔試場地可穿着黑底鞋。體育組辦事處備有球拍供借用。

english: Staff clear the cage before the morning delivery. Flatten empty cartons before placing them in the collection cage.
chinese: 職員會在早上送貨前清空回收籠。空紙箱放入回收籠前，須先壓平。

english: You will receive your own booking reference if the transfer goes through. Contact the booking volunteer after the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot. Equipment requests are recorded on a separate form.
chinese: 轉讓成功後，你會獲發自己的預約編號。原租用者確認釋出時段後，方可聯絡處理預約的義工。器材申請另用表格記錄。

english: Pull the latch outward to lower the trolley handle. Do not rest your free hand on the hinge.
chinese: 向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。請勿將另一隻手放在鉸位上。

english: Overshoes are required in the changing corridor. Shoes can be stored in the racks by the entrance.
chinese: 可將鞋履放在入口旁的鞋架上。須在接待處穿上鞋套。

english: Members may add removable notes to the loan copy. The discussion guide is attached to this email.
chinese: 討論指引見本電郵附件。會員可在借閱本貼上可移除的便條。

english: Students may use their preferred first name in the yearbook. Check your name on the proof circulated by your class teacher.
chinese: 學生可在畢業紀念冊使用自己選用的名字。班主任派發校樣後，請核對你的姓名。

english: Hold the frame steady until the image transfers. Insert the artwork with the inked face down.
chinese: 放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝下。請固定框架，直至圖案轉印完成。

english: The declared serving size should be clearly visible. State whether the nutrition figures are for the product as sold or as prepared.
chinese: 標示的食用分量應清楚顯示。須列明營養數值是按出售時還是調配後的產品計算。

english: If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first. The exhibition covers several periods of local history. Teachers distribute the sketching sheets on the bus.
chinese: 學生借出影印本前，須先清除背面的個人筆記。展覽涵蓋本地歷史的不同時期。老師會在旅遊車上派發速寫紙。

english: Keep the same heat setting while comparing samples. A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area. Record the total number of accepted samples on the batch sheet.
chinese: 比較樣本時須維持相同的加熱設定。請在批次紀錄表填上獲接納的樣本總數。樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按完好樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。

english: Tell the registry which language will be used for interpretation. The interpreter must be at least 18 years old.
chinese: 傳譯員須年滿18歲。請向登記處說明傳譯所用的語言。

english: The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses. Each house can check its full breakdown with the quiz convenor.
chinese: 各社隊可向問答比賽召集人查閱本隊的詳細得分。計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。

english: The clearance certificate remains valid for twelve months after issue. The certificate states the address of the unit.
chinese: 證明書列明單位地址。合格證明書自簽發日起六個月內有效。

english: The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast. A short synopsis will precede each interview.
chinese: 每節訪問前會簡介訪問內容。錄音播出前須取得受訪者同意。

english: A large-print copy is available on request. Members may add removable notes to the loan copy.
chinese: 可按需要索取大字版本。會員可在借閱本貼上可移除的便條。

english: Flatten empty cartons before placing them in the collection cage. Do not put fish waste in the carton cage.
chinese: 魚類廢物不得放入紙箱回收籠。空紙箱須保持原狀放入回收籠。

english: Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter.
chinese: 將飲品單交到櫃檯前，請先填上桌號。

english: Each pupil may check out up to two dictionaries at once. Place damaged volumes on the teacher's desk.
chinese: 每名學生同時最多可借用三本字典。有破損的字典請放在教師桌上。

english: For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water after supply has resumed. Operators can check the restoration time in the repair log. Urgent safety calls continue to go straight to the response team.
chinese: 接線人員可在維修紀錄查閱恢復供水時間。緊急安全求助仍直接轉介應變小組。水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。

english: Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session. Keep cleaning materials in the maintenance cupboard.
chinese: 清潔物料請存放於保養用品櫃。

english: Remove the adhesive strip before folding the insert. Orient the printed arrows towards the top opening.
chinese: 請將印上的箭嘴指向頂部開口。摺疊內襯前，請先移除黏貼帶。

english: Students must use their registered first name in the yearbook. Use the spelling you want printed.
chinese: 請填寫你希望印在紀念冊上的拼法。學生可在畢業紀念冊使用自己選用的名字。

english: A volunteer keeps a list of the contributions received. The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group. We will send a separate message when the transcript is ready.
chinese: 義工會備存已收到的分享內容清單。故事分享小組保留錄音只供內部謄寫，並會向小組成員分享經編輯的文字稿。文字稿備妥後我們會另行通知。

english: Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts.
chinese: 選拔試場地禁止穿着黑底鞋。

english: Leave enough space for the inspector to reach the shutoff valve. A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand. Residents may appoint someone to open the door for them.
chinese: 請預留足夠空間，方便檢查人員接觸截流閥。如有單位未能接受檢查，只須為該單位另作安排，其他單位的預約維持原定時間。住戶可委託他人代為開門。

english: Please keep the badge visible throughout the tour. Each group collects its badges together at the start of the tour. The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition only during a live demonstration.
chinese: 導賞期間請全程在顯眼處佩戴臨時證。各組別須在導賞開始時一同領取臨時證。臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地，但現場示範期間除外。

english: New members receive their own membership number. The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, provided that both renew together. A single receipt lists the names of all members covered by the payment.
chinese: 即使分開續會，同住的兄弟姊妹亦可獲社團豁免第二人的會費。收據會列出同一筆款項所涵蓋的全體會員姓名。新會員各有獨立會員編號。

english: The clearance certificate remains valid for six months after issue. Keep a copy with the tenancy documents.
chinese: 請把副本與租賃文件一併保存。合格證明書自簽發日起六個月內有效。

english: The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section B of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting. Keep the instrument cover with the drum itself.
chinese: 清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊B欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。鼓罩須與鼓一同存放。

english: The corner should sit flush against both sides of the jig. Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner still moves after you release the inner guide. Do not apply glue while checking the fit.
chinese: 放開內導件後，如角位仍會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。檢查接合位置時請勿塗膠。角位應貼合定位夾具的兩邊。

english: The screening includes audio description. A short discussion will follow the screening.
chinese: 放映完畢後會有簡短討論。放映場次設有口述影像服務。

english: The receiving institution keeps its own copy of the form. The student supplies their own application number. A student may preview the factual information on a reference form, but the teacher's comments remain confidential.
chinese: 接收院校會自行存檔。學生須自行提供申請編號。學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料及教師評語。

english: The review panel meets monthly. Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file. Senders may request confirmation of receipt.
chinese: 評審小組每月開會。附交的插圖須退回寄件人，隨附函件則留在項目檔案。寄件人可要求確認收件。

english: Keep the base of the jig clear of sawdust. Do not apply glue while checking the fit. Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner still moves after you release the inner guide.
chinese: 檢查接合位置時請勿塗膠。放開內導件後，如角位仍會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。定位夾具底座不得積有木屑。

english: Spelling corrections can be added in the shared document. Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments. The host will send the final transcript to the guest.
chinese: 主持人會把最終文字稿交給嘉賓。可在共用文件加入拼寫更正。

english: Keep the unedited track in the production folder. The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast.
chinese: 錄音播出前須取得受訪者同意。請在製作資料夾保留未經剪輯的音軌。

english: Please copy the current pin label into your message. The map editor checks for duplicate locations. We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it.
chinese: 地圖編輯人員會檢查是否有重複地點。地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認，便可更改。請在訊息內抄錄現有地圖標記的標籤。

english: If a caller disputes the transcript, retain the caller's written correction alongside the original. Record the date on which the original transcript was shared. Case officers may refer records to the review team.
chinese: 如來電者對通話文字記錄有異議，須將來電者提交的書面更正與原文一併保存。請記錄發出原有文字記錄的日期。個案主任可把紀錄轉交覆核小組。

english: Volume may be adjusted to suit the room. Set the keyboard to the acoustic piano sound for the practical assessment.
chinese: 實習評核須把電子琴設定為原聲鋼琴音色。可因應房間情況調節音量。

english: Seal the stall's cash pouch before handing it over. Include the stall name on the collection slip.
chinese: 請在交收單填上攤位名稱。

english: If the storage sleeve feels damp, replace the sleeve before putting the objective away. Return the objective to its labelled drawer.
chinese: 如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。請將物鏡放回有相應標籤的抽屜。

english: The showcase includes coursework and written comments. The digital catalogue uses the same showcase rules. When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work from the showcase but retain anonymous remarks unless the remarks identify them. Consent records are held by the year coordinator.
chinese: 展覽包含學生習作及書面評語。電子圖錄適用相同的展示規則。學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。同意紀錄由年級統籌主任保管。

english: The image format is the same under both profiles. The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. For a public demonstration, enable the second profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through.
chinese: 兩個設定檔所用的影像格式相同。第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。

english: Do not rest your free hand on the hinge. Push the latch inward to lower the trolley handle.
chinese: 請勿將另一隻手放在鉸位上。向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。

english: The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast.
chinese: 錄音播出前須取得受訪者同意。

english: An appointment can be booked without a referral. Notify the learning support coordinator if you cannot attend your appointment.
chinese: 如未能出席預約時段，請通知學習支援統籌主任。學生毋須轉介即可預約。

english: The officer receiving the property signs the inventory. The inventory carries the case number.
chinese: 物品清單載有個案編號。物品清單由發還遺物的人員簽署。

english: Each house can check its full breakdown with the quiz convenor. The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses.
chinese: 計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。各社隊可向問答比賽召集人查閱本隊的詳細得分。

english: Remove the adhesive strip before folding the insert.
chinese: 摺疊內襯前，請先移除黏貼帶。

english: Attach the brace to the rear leg. The stand should support an empty folder during the first check.
chinese: 請將支撐桿接到後腳。首次檢查時，譜架應能承托一個空文件夾。

english: The desk volunteer checks the voucher record before confirming eligibility. Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed. Keep any redeemed voucher number for your records.
chinese: 櫃檯義工會先查閱券的紀錄，再確認資格。藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用黃色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。請自行保存已兌換的券號。

english: Mentors are matched to students by field of interest. The first meeting takes place online.
chinese: 首次會面以網上形式進行。校友導師與學生按年級配對。

english: Record the water temperature at the sampling point. Use the sterile glass bottle supplied with the sampling kit.
chinese: 請記錄採樣點的水溫。請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。

english: Flatten empty cartons before placing them in the collection cage.
chinese: 空紙箱放入回收籠前，須先壓平。

english: Overshoes are required in the changing corridor. A small supply of spare overshoes is available at the desk.
chinese: 進入更衣走廊須穿上鞋套。接待櫃檯備有少量鞋套供取用。

english: Pull the latch outward to lower the trolley handle. Leave the platform empty while adjusting the handle.
chinese: 調整手柄時，平台上不得放置物件。向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。

english: The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days.
chinese: 紗線樣本可免費借用十天。

english: Please keep phone conversations outside the quiet floor. Other seats can be used without a booking. A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present.
chinese: 請離開安靜樓層後才通電話。其他座位毋須預約。即使所陪同的讀者不在場，陪同者亦可使用安靜樓層的預留座位。

english: The grounds team will inspect seed growth each week. The lawn can reopen after seeding, except in the marked section beside the shelter.
chinese: 草地完成播種後可重開，但涼亭旁有標記的部分除外。園務小組會每周檢查種子生長情況。

english: Stand the pole tip-down to dry the lower shaft. Store the pole indoors once dry.
chinese: 請將手杖杖尖朝下直立，讓下節杖管風乾。風乾後請在室內存放手杖。

english: Apply one light coat to the practice sketch. Leave the sketch to dry before putting it in a sleeve.
chinese: 請在練習素描上薄噴兩層定畫液。素描乾透後才可放入保護套。

english: Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation. The invoice should identify the model where available.
chinese: 如型號可查，發票應列出型號。以資助金購買的器材歸受資助機構所有。

english: Leave your towel on the poolside rack. Enter the water after the second whistle.
chinese: 第二下哨聲響起後方可下水。請把毛巾放在池邊架上。

english: Existing route bookings remain available to the replacement guide. The system sends a confirmation when a token is deactivated. When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate their lead-guide token immediately and retain any observer token until the end of the current tour. The register records the role attached to each token.
chinese: 接任導賞員仍可使用已預約的路線時段。通行憑證停用後，系統會發出確認通知。導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊及任何觀察員通行憑證。登記冊列明每個通行憑證所對應的身分。

english: Tell us if the piano has a separate bench. The donor arranges delivery to the community room.
chinese: 捐贈者須安排把鋼琴送至社區活動室。如鋼琴附有獨立琴凳，請告知我們。

english: Pupils may keep the spare sheets after the outing. If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first.
chinese: 學生借出影印本前，須先清除背面的個人筆記。活動結束後學生可保留剩餘的畫紙。

english: Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth. Check the labels for lifting edges after cleaning.
chinese: 清潔完畢後請檢查標籤邊緣有否翹起。請用濕棉布清潔凸字標籤。

english: Note any visible surface film in the field log. Use the sterile glass bottle supplied with the sampling kit.
chinese: 請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。如水面有可見薄膜，請在實地紀錄簿註明。

english: The attendance system keeps a separate list for each session. An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available.
chinese: 退出發布的選擇只適用於影片，文字記錄仍可供查閱。考勤系統會分別保存每節活動的出席名單。

english: Mentors are matched to students by field of interest. The first meeting takes place online.
chinese: 首次會面以網上形式進行。校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。

english: The checkout log tracks which magnification is in use. Remove the objective without touching the glass.
chinese: 借用紀錄列明正在使用的放大倍率。取出物鏡時請勿觸碰鏡片。如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。

english: The invoice should identify the model where available. Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation.
chinese: 以資助金購買的器材歸受資助機構所有。如型號可查，發票應列出型號。

english: Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, including when they have changed instruments in the meantime. Instrument cases stay in the green room during rehearsal. There is a separate sound check at the performance venue. The school check uses the performance seating plan.
chinese: 彩排期間，樂器盒須留在後台休息室。演出場地另設試音環節。學校試音按演出座位表安排。外來樂手如已完成場地試音，可豁免學校試音，但其間曾更換樂器者除外。

english: The account shows the sequence of transfers. The canteen may record the case without immediately changing the balance. If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds. The payment provider receives the reference number by secure message.
chinese: 帳戶會顯示各次轉移的先後次序。飯堂可先登記事件，毋須即時調整結餘。如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷首次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理第二次轉移。參考編號會以保安訊息發給付款服務商。

english: Set the right margin to 8 mm before printing the labels. Use a ruler to check the first printed label.
chinese: 請用間尺核對第一張已列印的標籤。列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為8毫米。

english: A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present. A map identifies the reserved desks. Other seats can be used without a booking.
chinese: 陪同者只可在所陪同的讀者在場時，使用安靜樓層的預留座位。平面圖上標有預留書桌的位置。其他座位毋須預約。

english: The discussion guide is attached to this email. Members may add removable notes to the loan copy.
chinese: 會員可在借閱本貼上可移除的便條。討論指引見本電郵附件。

english: State whether the nutrition figures are for the product as sold or as prepared. Use a legible type size throughout the panel.
chinese: 整個標籤須使用易於閱讀的字體大小。須列明營養數值是按出售時還是調配後的產品計算。

english: Other seats can be used without a booking. A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present. A map identifies the reserved desks.
chinese: 即使所陪同的讀者不在場，陪同者亦可使用安靜樓層的預留座位。平面圖上標有預留書桌的位置。其他座位毋須預約。

english: Only the registered resident may return the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may collect it. The guard will enter the remote's number in the issue log. Notify the management office if the remote stops working.
chinese: 保安員會在借出紀錄簿填寫遙控器編號。如遙控器失靈，請通知管理處。借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶領取，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可歸還。

english: Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script. The booth keeps a printed working copy.
chinese: 控制室備有供工作使用的紙本。舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本後，才可修改場務提示表。

english: Set the camera to record JPEG files for the lighting exercise. Use the same tripod for each exposure.
chinese: 每次曝光須使用同一個三腳架。進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存RAW檔案。

english: If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds. The canteen may record the case without immediately changing the balance. The account shows the sequence of transfers. The payment provider receives the reference number by secure message.
chinese: 飯堂可先登記事件，毋須即時調整結餘。帳戶會顯示各次轉移的先後次序。參考編號會以保安訊息發給付款服務商。如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷第二次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理首次轉移。

english: Use the new meter's opening reading as the billing baseline. A technician may ask to see the previous bill.
chinese: 技術員可能要求查閱上一期帳單。請以新水錶的起始讀數作為計費基準。

english: Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio.
chinese: 每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。

english: Samples of the colour palette are available at the exhibition. Each registered organisation has one vote on the mural shortlist.
chinese: 每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投一票。展覽現場備有色板樣本。

english: The register records the role attached to each token. When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate their lead-guide token immediately and retain any observer token until the end of the current tour. Existing route bookings remain available to the replacement guide.
chinese: 導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊通行憑證；觀察員通行憑證則保留至該次導賞完結。接任導賞員仍可使用已預約的路線時段。登記冊列明每個通行憑證所對應的身分。

english: Food scraps are sorted at the venue. Volunteers empty collection points at the end of the event. Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice.
chinese: 活動完結時由義工清空收集點。內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌，方可投放到堆肥收集系統。廚餘須在會場分類。

english: An inspector can explain the next steps to the tenant. The clearance certificate remains valid for six months after issue.
chinese: 檢查人員可向租戶解釋後續程序。合格證明書自簽發日起六個月內有效。

english: Visitors may take photographs during inspection. The register must remain in the inspection room.
chinese: 查閱登記冊時，訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。登記冊須留在查閱室內。

english: Set the keyboard to the electric piano sound for the practical assessment. Volume may be adjusted to suit the room.
chinese: 可因應房間情況調節音量。實習評核須把電子琴設定為原聲鋼琴音色。

english: A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present. A map identifies the reserved desks. Please keep phone conversations outside the quiet floor.
chinese: 平面圖上標有預留書桌的位置。請離開安靜樓層後才通電話。即使所陪同的讀者不在場，陪同者亦可使用安靜樓層的預留座位。

english: Use the preview to verify each row number. The master worksheet remains unchanged by the export. Export all verified rows, and suppress the notes column for rows with personal data.
chinese: 匯出資料不會改動主工作表。須匯出所有已核實的資料列，但包含個人資料的資料列不輸出備註欄內容。請在預覽中核對每個資料列編號。

english: Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence. You can change your email address after activation.
chinese: 服務啟用後可更改電郵地址。啟用電子函件服務須使用本期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。

english: You can transfer your repair appointment to another household member. Use the side door to reach the waiting area.
chinese: 你可把維修預約轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。請經側門前往等候區。

english: The declared serving size should be clearly visible.
chinese: 須列明營養數值是按出售時還是調配後的產品計算。標示的食用分量應清楚顯示。

english: Include the survey pole in the frame. Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath above it.
chinese: 請從擋土牆上方的行人徑拍攝牆身。相片須攝入測量桿。

english: Attach the white tag to the new clothesline. The tag helps caretakers identify the flat using the line.
chinese: 管理員可憑標籤辨識使用晾衣繩的單位。請在新晾衣繩掛上藍色標籤。

english: Pupils may keep the spare sheets after the outing. If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first. Teachers distribute the sketching sheets on the bus.
chinese: 活動結束後學生可保留剩餘的畫紙。學生借出影印本前，須先清除背面的個人筆記。老師會在旅遊車上派發速寫紙。

english: Store the items in a sealed container. The officer receiving the property signs the inventory.
chinese: 物品清單由接收遺物的人員簽署。遺物須存放於密封容器內。

english: The examiner will provide a foot pedal. Set the keyboard to the acoustic piano sound for the practical assessment.
chinese: 考官會提供腳踏板。實習評核須把電子琴設定為原聲鋼琴音色。

english: You cannot transfer your repair appointment to another household member. Spare parts are subject to availability.
chinese: 零件供應視乎存貨而定。你可把維修預約轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。

english: Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim. Staff may contact applicants to clarify unusual purchases.
chinese: 申請發還款項時須提交分項發票。職員可聯絡申請人查問不尋常的購買項目。

english: The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses. An asterisk indicates a tied score.
chinese: 同分以星號標示。計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。

english: Set the camera to record RAW files for the lighting exercise. Make a note of the light direction.
chinese: 請記下光線的方向。進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存RAW檔案。

english: When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate their lead-guide token immediately and retain any observer token until the end of the current tour. The system sends a confirmation when a token is deactivated. The register records the role attached to each token. Existing route bookings remain available to the replacement guide.
chinese: 通行憑證停用後，系統會發出確認通知。登記冊列明每個通行憑證所對應的身分。接任導賞員仍可使用已預約的路線時段。導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊及任何觀察員通行憑證。

english: The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast. Students may suggest interview questions at the editorial meeting.
chinese: 錄音播出前須取得受訪者同意。學生可於編輯會議提出訪問問題。

english: The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, provided that both renew together. New members receive their own membership number.
chinese: 新會員各有獨立會員編號。同住的兄弟姊妹如一同續會，社團可豁免第二人的會費。

english: You can transfer your repair appointment to another household member. Only bring the item listed on the booking form.
chinese: 請只帶同預約表所列的物品。你可把維修預約轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。

english: The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition, except during a live demonstration. Visitors may wait in the foyer while a demonstration is running. Please keep the badge visible throughout the tour.
chinese: 現場示範期間，訪客可在大堂等候。導賞期間請全程在顯眼處佩戴臨時證。臨時證持有人只可在現場示範期間進入展覽場地。

english: Only the registered resident may collect the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may return it. The loan slip shows the temporary access period.
chinese: 借用單列明臨時通行的期限。借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶領取，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可歸還。

english: The installation sheet has a diagram of the clip locations. Check that the cabinet is level before filling it. Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place.
chinese: 安裝說明附有夾具位置圖。放入物品前須確認展示櫃放置平穩。安裝後只須拆除固定可拆式層板的運輸固定夾。

english: Write the scene number beside each change. Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script. Use the shared folder to file the rehearsal notes.
chinese: 舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本後，才可修改場務提示表。彩排紀錄須存入共用資料夾。請在各項變更旁註明場次。

english: If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold the complainant's home address but a site address that identifies only the mural may be retained. The case file contains contact and site details. The published list is updated after each review cycle.
chinese: 如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址，但可保留只用作識別壁畫位置的地址。個案檔案載有聯絡資料及場地資料。公眾名單會在每輪審核後更新。

english: Students must use their registered first name in the yearbook. Check your name on the proof circulated by your class teacher.
chinese: 學生可在畢業紀念冊使用自己選用的名字。班主任派發校樣後，請核對你的姓名。

english: A short synopsis will precede each interview. The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast.
chinese: 錄音播出前須取得受訪者同意。每節訪問前會簡介訪問內容。

english: The officer receiving the property signs the inventory. A copy of the inventory is filed with the case papers.
chinese: 物品清單由接收遺物的人員簽署。物品清單的副本會與個案文件一併存檔。

english: Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review. Keep teacher comments with the corresponding drafts.
chinese: 教師的評語應與相應的草稿一併保存。完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾一個學期。

english: When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work and all anonymous remarks from the showcase. The digital catalogue uses the same showcase rules. The showcase includes coursework and written comments. Consent records are held by the year coordinator.
chinese: 電子圖錄適用相同的展示規則。展覽包含學生習作及書面評語。同意紀錄由年級統籌主任保管。學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。

english: Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath above it. Include the survey pole in the frame.
chinese: 相片須攝入測量桿。請從擋土牆上方的行人徑拍攝牆身。

english: A staff member will check the corridor before each session. Overshoes are required in the changing corridor.
chinese: 進入更衣走廊須穿上鞋套。職員會在每節活動開始前檢查走廊。

english: Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth. Report missing labels to the equipment librarian.
chinese: 請用濕棉布清潔凸字標籤。如有標籤遺失，請通知器材管理員。

english: Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio. Use headphones when reviewing recordings in class.
chinese: 在課堂上重聽錄音時，請戴上耳機。每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。

english: Return unused labels to the storage bag. Set the right margin to 8 mm before printing the labels.
chinese: 列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為8毫米。請將未使用的標籤放回儲存袋。

english: A technician may ask to see the previous bill. Use the new meter's opening reading as the billing baseline.
chinese: 請以新水錶的起始讀數作為計費基準。技術員可能要求查閱上一期帳單。

english: Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script. Write the scene number beside each change. The booth keeps a printed working copy.
chinese: 舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本後，才可修改場務提示表。請在各項變更旁註明場次。控制室備有供工作使用的紙本。

english: Please mark the chapter you want to discuss. Members may add removable notes to the loan copy.
chinese: 會員可在借閱本貼上可移除的便條。請標示你希望討論的章節。

english: In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the first code in the log key. Each cassette should be logged by its title.
chinese: 每盒錄音帶須按其標題登記。紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第二個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: Use a legible type size throughout the panel. State whether the nutrition figures are for the product as sold or as prepared.
chinese: 須列明營養數值是按出售時還是調配後的產品計算。整個標籤須使用易於閱讀的字體大小。

english: Stand the pole tip-down to dry the lower shaft. Keep the wrist strap away from the drying surface.
chinese: 請避免腕帶接觸風乾用的表面。請將手杖杖尖朝下直立，讓下節杖管風乾。

english: Export all verified rows, and suppress the notes column for rows with personal data. Use the preview to verify each row number.
chinese: 請在預覽中核對每個資料列編號。須匯出所有已核實的資料列，但包含個人資料的資料列不輸出備註欄內容。

english: You will receive your own booking reference if the transfer goes through. Contact the booking volunteer after the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot.
chinese: 原租用者確認釋出時段後，方可聯絡處理預約的義工。轉讓成功後，你會獲發自己的預約編號。

english: Record the microchip number shown by the scanner. The receipt lists the date of examination.
chinese: 收據列有檢查日期。請記錄晶片掃描器所顯示的號碼。

english: In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Place the rewound cassettes in the padded box. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the first code in the log key.
chinese: 紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。已回帶的錄音帶請放進有襯墊的存放盒。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第一個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: Return the temporary lunch card in person. Write your student number on the lending slip.
chinese: 請在借用單上填寫學生編號。臨時午膳卡須親身交還。

english: The briefing recording may be released with the speaker's consent. A separate leaflet explains the proposed works.
chinese: 工程建議另有單張介紹。取得講者同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。

english: If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold both the complainant's home address and any site address identifying the mural. The published list is updated after each review cycle. The case file contains contact and site details. The contractor can request a map for its work crew.
chinese: 公眾名單會在每輪審核後更新。個案檔案載有聯絡資料及場地資料。承辦商可索取地圖供工作隊使用。如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址，但可保留只用作識別壁畫位置的地址。

english: Scrap metal goes into a separate container. Keep the signed form in the works file. Return serviceable road studs to stores only after the inspection team signs the recovery sheet.
chinese: 已簽署的表格須存放於工程檔案。狀況良好的路面反光標只能在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄後送回物料倉。廢金屬須放入另一容器。

english: Use the new meter's opening reading as the billing baseline. The property account number remains the same.
chinese: 請以新水錶的起始讀數作為計費基準。處所的帳戶號碼維持不變。

english: Flatten empty cartons before placing them in the collection cage. Staff clear the cage before the morning delivery.
chinese: 空紙箱須保持原狀放入回收籠。職員會在早上送貨前清空回收籠。

english: Name badges are available for both members and guests. Each member may bring one guest on the walk.
chinese: 會員和賓客均可領取姓名牌。每名會員可攜同一名賓客參加步行導賞。

english: Staff may contact applicants to clarify unusual purchases. Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim.
chinese: 職員可聯絡申請人查問不尋常的購買項目。申請發還款項時須提交分項發票。

english: Include the stall name on the collection slip. Seal the stall's cash pouch before handing it over.
chinese: 攤位交收現金袋前，須先將袋口封妥。請在交收單填上攤位名稱。

english: Keep the bag of spare fixings in the cover pocket. Use the 12 mm screw to join the binder covers.
chinese: 請把備用配件放在封面內袋。請用12毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。

english: The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. The image format is the same under both profiles. For a public demonstration, enable the second profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through.
chinese: 兩個設定檔所用的影像格式相同。第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。

english: Attach the white tag to the new clothesline. Please avoid hanging wet items over the footpath.
chinese: 請在新晾衣繩掛上白色標籤。請勿把濕衣物晾掛在行人徑上方。

english: The register records the role attached to each token. Existing route bookings remain available to the replacement guide. When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate their lead-guide token immediately and retain any observer token until the end of the current tour.
chinese: 接任導賞員仍可使用已預約的路線時段。導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊通行憑證；觀察員通行憑證則保留至該次導賞完結。登記冊列明每個通行憑證所對應的身分。

english: Club members can flag duplicate images for the editor. Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed.
chinese: 只有在刪除坐標後，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。學會會員可標記重複相片，供編輯處理。

english: Connect the pedal directly to the computer. Assign the left pedal to page back.
chinese: 請把踏板直接接駁到電腦。請將左踏板設定為翻至上一頁。

english: Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence. The demand number can be found next to the billing address.
chinese: 繳款通知書編號列於帳單地址旁。啟用電子函件服務須使用上一期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。

english: Keep the filled bottle cool during transport. Use the sterile glass bottle supplied with the sampling kit.
chinese: 請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。裝妥樣本後，運送時須保持樣本瓶低溫。

english: Participants will be given a list of suggested discussion topics. Mentors are matched to students by field of interest.
chinese: 參加者會收到一份建議討論題目清單。校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。

english: Return the objective to its labelled drawer. The checkout log tracks which magnification is in use.
chinese: 請將物鏡放回有相應標籤的抽屜。借用紀錄列明正在使用的放大倍率。如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。

english: Overshoes are required in the changing corridor. A staff member will check the corridor before each session.
chinese: 職員會在每節活動開始前檢查走廊。進入更衣走廊須穿上鞋套。

english: Only the registered resident may collect the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may return it. The guard will enter the remote's number in the issue log. The loan slip shows the temporary access period.
chinese: 借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶領取，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可歸還。保安員會在借出紀錄簿填寫遙控器編號。借用單列明臨時通行的期限。

english: Submit the price quotation with the reimbursement claim. Keep a copy of the claim for your own records.
chinese: 請自行保存申請表副本。申請發還款項時須提交分項發票。

english: You can change your email address after activation. Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence.
chinese: 啟用電子函件服務須使用本期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。服務啟用後可更改電郵地址。

english: Set the camera to record RAW files for the lighting exercise. The memory cards may be collected from the technician.
chinese: 進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存JPEG檔案。記憶卡可向技術員領取。

english: Stand the pole tip-down to dry the lower shaft.
chinese: 請將手杖杖尖朝下直立，讓下節杖管風乾。

english: The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top five houses. Question scores are entered after each round.
chinese: 計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。每輪結束後會輸入該輪題目的得分。

english: Return the temporary lunch card in person. Unused meal credits remain on your regular account.
chinese: 臨時午膳卡須親身交還。未使用的午膳金額仍存於原有帳戶。

english: Return the temporary lunch card in person. Remove the plastic holder before handing back the card.
chinese: 交還午膳卡前，請取下膠套。臨時午膳卡須經校內郵遞交還。

english: Place the rewound cassettes in the padded box. In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the second code in the log key.
chinese: 已回帶的錄音帶請放進有襯墊的存放盒。紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第一個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: The inspection sheet records the date of installation. Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink.
chinese: 濕度指示卡有三格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。檢查表載有安裝日期。

english: Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath above it. The photographic record is attached to the maintenance report.
chinese: 請從擋土牆上方的行人徑拍攝牆身。相片紀錄將附於保養報告。

english: Line the collection box with a paper bag. The box is emptied by the caretakers.
chinese: 請在收集箱內鋪上紙袋。收集箱由管理員清空。

english: Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice. Clean liners are stocked at the reception desk. Food scraps are sorted at the venue.
chinese: 內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌，方可投放到堆肥收集系統。接待處備有清潔的內袋。廚餘須在會場分類。

english: The café meeting point is the same for both routes. The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, except for participants already assigned a shuttle.
chinese: 如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者除外。兩條路線的集合地點均為同一間咖啡店。

english: The secretary will confirm any change of address before updating the register. New members receive their own membership number. The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, even if they renew separately.
chinese: 秘書會先確認地址變更，再更新會員名冊。新會員各有獨立會員編號。同住的兄弟姊妹如一同續會，社團可豁免第二人的會費。

english: Record the location of each recovered item. Return serviceable road studs to stores only after the inspection team signs the recovery sheet. Keep the signed form in the works file.
chinese: 狀況良好的路面反光標只能在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄後送回物料倉。已簽署的表格須存放於工程檔案。請記錄每件回收物品的位置。

english: Record the microchip number shown by the scanner. Entries are linked to the animal's licence file.
chinese: 請記錄晶片掃描器所顯示的號碼。紀錄會與該動物的牌照檔案相連。

english: Use the shared folder to file the rehearsal notes. The booth keeps a printed working copy. Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script.
chinese: 彩排紀錄須存入共用資料夾。控制室備有供工作使用的紙本。須在舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本前修改場務提示表。

english: Set the keyboard to the acoustic piano sound for the practical assessment. The examiner will provide a foot pedal.
chinese: 實習評核須把電子琴設定為電鋼琴音色。考官會提供腳踏板。

english: Only completed matches count towards ladder points.
chinese: 只有打完的比賽才計入排名賽積分。

english: The tournament secretary flags an unauthorised substitute, and the referee corrects the team sheet. Keep the original team sheet with the match report. A note should record when the substitute entered the pitch.
chinese: 請把原有隊伍名單與比賽報告一併保存。紀錄應註明替補球員上場的時間。未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。

english: Attach the brace to the rear leg. Set the music stand on a level surface before working on it.
chinese: 操作前請把譜架放在平坦表面。請將支撐桿接到前腳。

english: Record the time when the oil sheen was reported. Describe the appearance of the sheen in the incident log.
chinese: 請在事故紀錄內描述油膜的外觀。請記錄首次發現油膜的時間。

english: The master worksheet remains unchanged by the export. Use the preview to verify each row number. Export all verified rows, and suppress the notes column for rows with personal data.
chinese: 匯出資料不會改動主工作表。請在預覽中核對每個資料列編號。只匯出不含個人資料的已核實資料列。

english: Staff can help locate drawings by address. Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site and obtain copies without written permission. General background notes can be downloaded from the consultation page.
chinese: 訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，但須有書面許可方可取得副本。一般背景資料可從諮詢網頁下載。職員可協助按地址找出圖則。

english: Slides will be shared separately by the presenter. An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available. The seminar is recorded for students who miss the live session.
chinese: 退出發布的選擇同時適用於影片及文字記錄。研討會設錄影，方便未能出席的學生。講者會另行分享投影片。

english: A note should record when the substitute entered the pitch. The referee flags an unauthorised substitute, and the tournament secretary corrects the team sheet.
chinese: 未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。紀錄應註明替補球員上場的時間。

english: Attach the white tag to the new clothesline. The tag helps caretakers identify the flat using the line.
chinese: 管理員可憑標籤辨識使用晾衣繩的單位。請在新晾衣繩掛上白色標籤。

english: Members may add removable notes to the loan copy.
chinese: 會員可在借閱本貼上可移除的便條。

english: The panel will publish a summary of the feedback received. Each registered organisation has one vote on the mural shortlist.
chinese: 評審小組會公布收到的意見摘要。每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投一票。

english: The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section B of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting. The receptionist confirms which items have been returned.
chinese: 接待員會確認已交還的物品。清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊B欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。

english: Captains may inspect the updated register after the match. The tournament secretary flags an unauthorised substitute, and the referee corrects the team sheet. Keep the original team sheet with the match report.
chinese: 未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。請把原有隊伍名單與比賽報告一併保存。賽後隊長可查閱已更新的紀錄。

english: Keep bags outside the playing area. Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts.
chinese: 選拔試場地禁止穿着黑底鞋。請把球袋放在比賽範圍以外。

english: We will send a separate message when the transcript is ready. The circle shares both the audio and edited text with the group. Speakers may suggest amendments to the edited text.
chinese: 故事分享小組保留錄音只供內部謄寫，並會向小組成員分享經編輯的文字稿。講述者可就文字稿提出修訂建議。文字稿備妥後我們會另行通知。

english: Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen. Mark the approximate position on the harbour chart.
chinese: 請記錄首次發現油膜的時間。請在海圖上標示大概位置。

english: Use laminated card for the portfolio divider sheets. The cover may be reused from an earlier project.
chinese: 作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。封面可沿用以往專題研習的封面。

english: Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen. Mark the approximate position on the harbour chart.
chinese: 請記錄接獲油膜報告的時間。請在海圖上標示大概位置。

english: Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation. The grant report may include photos of the equipment in use.
chinese: 以資助金購買的器材歸撥款部門所有。資助報告可附上使用器材的相片。

english: Enter the water after the second whistle. The coach will distribute caps at the warm-up area.
chinese: 教練會在熱身區派發泳帽。第二下哨聲響起後方可下水。

english: Please keep the badge visible throughout the tour. The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition, except during a live demonstration.
chinese: 臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地，但現場示範期間除外。導賞期間請全程在顯眼處佩戴臨時證。

english: Keep the writing folder for two terms after the final review. Number the drafts in chronological order.
chinese: 請按日期先後為各份草稿編號。完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾一個學期。

english: Pay the jar deposit in cash. The jar sizes are listed on the order form.
chinese: 訂購表列有各款玻璃瓶的容量。玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。

english: The petty cash float is capped at HK$400. The float is counted at the end of each meeting.
chinese: 每次會議完結時須點算備用現金。零用現金備用額上限為港幣450元。

english: Attach the white tag to the new clothesline.
chinese: 請在新晾衣繩掛上白色標籤。

english: Use the new meter's opening reading as the billing baseline. The property account number remains the same.
chinese: 請以舊水錶的終結讀數作為計費基準。處所的帳戶號碼維持不變。

english: Keep the event organiser's telephone number with you. The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, except for participants already assigned a shuttle. A final route note will be shared before the event.
chinese: 如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者亦適用。活動前會發出最終路線通知。請隨身備存活動主辦人的電話號碼。

english: The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days. Use the sample book to record the shade number.
chinese: 請將色號記在樣本冊上。紗線樣本可免費借用十天。

english: The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast. Students may suggest interview questions at the editorial meeting.
chinese: 錄音播出前須取得訪問者同意。學生可於編輯會議提出訪問問題。

english: Use the verification code printed on your previous rates demand to activate digital correspondence. You will receive a confirmation email once the service is active.
chinese: 啟用電子函件服務須使用本期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。服務啟用後會發出確認電郵。

english: Apply one light coat to the practice sketch.
chinese: 請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。

english: When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate their lead-guide token immediately and retain any observer token until the end of the current tour. The register records the role attached to each token. The system sends a confirmation when a token is deactivated.
chinese: 導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊通行憑證；觀察員通行憑證則保留至該次導賞完結。登記冊列明每個通行憑證所對應的身分。通行憑證停用後，系統會發出確認通知。

english: Use the sterile plastic bottle supplied with the sampling kit. Record the water temperature at the sampling point.
chinese: 請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。請記錄採樣點的水溫。

english: The petty cash float is capped at HK$400.
chinese: 零用現金備用額上限為港幣400元。

english: Wrap each donated violin bow separately. The receiving school will acknowledge delivery by email.
chinese: 接收學校會以電郵確認收貨。每支捐贈的小提琴弓均須獨立包裹。

english: If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds. The canteen may record the case without immediately changing the balance. The payment provider receives the reference number by secure message.
chinese: 飯堂可先登記事件，毋須即時調整結餘。參考編號會以保安訊息發給付款服務商。如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷首次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理第二次轉移。

english: Case officers may refer records to the review team. The case reference appears at the top of each record. If a caller disputes the transcript, retain the caller's written correction alongside the original.
chinese: 每份紀錄的頂部均載有個案編號。如來電者對通話文字記錄有異議，須將來電者提交的書面更正與原文一併保存。個案主任可把紀錄轉交覆核小組。

english: The lawn can reopen after seeding, except in the marked section beside the shelter. The shelter itself remains available.
chinese: 涼亭照常開放。草地完成播種後可重開，但涼亭旁有標記的部分除外。

english: A final route note will be shared before the event. The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, except for participants already assigned a shuttle. The café meeting point is the same for both routes.
chinese: 如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者除外。兩條路線的集合地點均為同一間咖啡店。活動前會發出最終路線通知。

english: There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection. The inspection team will phone the tenant before visiting.
chinese: 檢查人員上門前會致電租戶。首次申請渠務檢查須繳付港幣50元。

english: You can track the request using the case number. There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection.
chinese: 可憑個案編號查詢進度。首次申請渠務檢查毋須繳費。

english: Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio. Begin the recording with the title of the passage.
chinese: 每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。開始錄音時，請先讀出篇章標題。

english: Write your student number on the lending slip. Return the temporary lunch card in person.
chinese: 臨時午膳卡須親身交還。請在借用單上填寫學生編號。

english: Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets. Keep photographs in removable sleeves.
chinese: 相片須放在可拆式透明套內。作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。

english: Use the 12 mm screw to join the binder covers. Make sure the punched holes align with the spacer.
chinese: 請確保打好的孔與墊片對齊。請用16毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。

english: Record the date on which the original transcript was shared. If a caller disputes the transcript, retain the caller's written correction alongside the original. The case reference appears at the top of each record.
chinese: 如來電者對通話文字記錄有異議，須將來電者提交的書面更正與原文一併保存。每份紀錄的頂部均載有個案編號。請記錄發出原有文字記錄的日期。

english: An asterisk indicates a tied score. The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses.
chinese: 計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。同分以星號標示。

english: Check that the cabinet is level before filling it. The installation sheet has a diagram of the clip locations. Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place.
chinese: 安裝說明附有夾具位置圖。安裝後須拆除運輸固定夾，但固定可拆式層板的夾具除外。放入物品前須確認展示櫃放置平穩。

english: Enter the water after the second whistle.
chinese: 第二下哨聲響起後方可下水。

english: Students may use their preferred first name in the yearbook. Class groups are listed separately.
chinese: 各班的名單會分開刊載。學生可在畢業紀念冊使用自己選用的名字。

english: Notify the learning support coordinator if you cannot attend your appointment. The appointment reminder contains a map of the building.
chinese: 如未能出席預約時段，請通知學習支援統籌主任。預約提示附有大樓位置圖。

english: When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work from the showcase but retain anonymous remarks unless the remarks identify them. The digital catalogue uses the same showcase rules. Consent records are held by the year coordinator.
chinese: 電子圖錄適用相同的展示規則。同意紀錄由年級統籌主任保管。學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。

english: Seal the stall's cash pouch before handing it over. Volunteers may sign out after packing the stall equipment.
chinese: 義工收妥攤位用品後可簽退。

english: The archive keeps the original issue available. Print the correction on the first page of the next issue.
chinese: 更正啟事須刊於下一期的首頁。資料庫仍可供查閱原有期刊。

english: The clearance certificate remains valid for twelve months after issue. Keep a copy with the tenancy documents.
chinese: 請把副本與租賃文件一併保存。合格證明書自簽發日起六個月內有效。

english: Place the rewound cassettes in the padded box. In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the first code in the log key.
chinese: 已回帶的錄音帶請放進有襯墊的存放盒。紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第一個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection.
chinese: 首次申請渠務檢查毋須繳費。

english: Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session.
chinese: 每次保養後，須記錄潤滑劑的批次編號。

english: Do not put fish waste in the carton cage. Flatten empty cartons before placing them in the collection cage.
chinese: 空紙箱放入回收籠前，須先壓平。魚類廢物不得放入紙箱回收籠。

english: Mentors are matched to students by year group. Participants will be given a list of suggested discussion topics.
chinese: 校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。參加者會收到一份建議討論題目清單。

english: The café meeting point is the same for both routes. Keep the event organiser's telephone number with you. The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, except for participants already assigned a shuttle.
chinese: 兩條路線的集合地點均為同一間咖啡店。請隨身備存活動主辦人的電話號碼。如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者亦適用。

english: A single receipt lists the names of all members covered by the payment. The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, provided that both renew together. The secretary will confirm any change of address before updating the register.
chinese: 同住的兄弟姊妹如一同續會，社團可豁免第二人的會費。秘書會先確認地址變更，再更新會員名冊。收據會列出同一筆款項所涵蓋的全體會員姓名。

english: State whether the nutrition figures are for the product as sold or as prepared.
chinese: 須列明營養數值是按出售時還是調配後的產品計算。

english: Bring any worksheets you wish to discuss. Notify the learning support coordinator if you cannot attend your appointment.
chinese: 如未能出席預約時段，請通知學習支援統籌主任。如有希望討論的工作紙，請一併帶來。

english: If a caller disputes the transcript, retain the caller's written correction alongside the original. Case officers may refer records to the review team.
chinese: 個案主任可把紀錄轉交覆核小組。如來電者對通話文字記錄有異議，須將來電者提交的書面更正與原文一併保存。

english: The shelter itself remains available. The lawn can reopen after seeding, including the marked section beside the shelter. The boundary is marked with low timber posts.
chinese: 草地完成播種後可重開，但涼亭旁有標記的部分除外。邊界設有矮木柱作標記。涼亭照常開放。

english: Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen.
chinese: 請記錄首次發現油膜的時間。

english: Use the 16 mm screw to join the binder covers. Start the thread by hand before tightening it with the tool.
chinese: 先用手旋入螺絲，再用工具擰緊。請用12毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。

english: The box is emptied by the caretakers. Line the collection box with a paper bag.
chinese: 收集箱由管理員清空。請在收集箱內鋪上紙袋。

english: Pay the jar deposit by bank transfer. One deposit is recorded for each jar.
chinese: 每個玻璃瓶的按金會分開記錄。玻璃瓶按金須以現金繳付。

english: When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work from the showcase but retain anonymous remarks unless the remarks identify them. The showcase includes coursework and written comments. The digital catalogue uses the same showcase rules.
chinese: 學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。展覽包含學生習作及書面評語。電子圖錄適用相同的展示規則。

english: Each pupil may check out up to two dictionaries at once. Write the accession number on the borrowing slip.
chinese: 請在借用單填寫館藏編號。每名學生同時最多可借用三本字典。

english: Assign the left pedal to page back. Connect the pedal directly to the computer.
chinese: 請將左踏板設定為翻至下一頁。請把踏板直接接駁到電腦。

english: The suspension decision is served by registered post. Officers retain a copy in the permit file.
chinese: 人員會在許可證檔案內保留副本。暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。

english: Remove any elastic bands around the newspapers. Line the collection box with a paper bag.
chinese: 請在收集箱內鋪上紙袋。請取下綑着報紙的橡皮圈。

english: The first meeting takes place online. Mentors are matched to students by field of interest.
chinese: 校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。首次會面以網上形式進行。

english: Each group collects its badges together at the start of the tour. Please keep the badge visible throughout the tour. The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition, except during a live demonstration.
chinese: 導賞期間請全程在顯眼處佩戴臨時證。臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地，但現場示範期間除外。各組別須在導賞開始時一同領取臨時證。

english: The case reference appears at the top of each record. Case officers may refer records to the review team.
chinese: 每份紀錄的頂部均載有個案編號。個案主任可把紀錄轉交覆核小組。如來電者對通話文字記錄有異議，須將來電者提交的書面更正與原文一併保存。

english: Visitors may take handwritten notes during inspection. Staff can explain the layout of the register.
chinese: 職員可解釋登記冊的編排。查閱登記冊時，訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。

english: Return the objective to its labelled drawer. If the storage sleeve feels damp, replace the sleeve before putting the objective away. The checkout log tracks which magnification is in use.
