chinese: 如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。借用紀錄列明正在使用的放大倍率。請將物鏡放回有相應標籤的抽屜。

english: Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation.
chinese: 以資助金購買的器材歸受資助機構所有。

english: Set the keyboard to the acoustic piano sound for the practical assessment. Volume may be adjusted to suit the room.
chinese: 可因應房間情況調節音量。實習評核須把電子琴設定為原聲鋼琴音色。

english: Shoes can be stored in the racks by the entrance. Overshoes are required in the changing corridor.
chinese: 進入更衣走廊須穿上鞋套。可將鞋履放在入口旁的鞋架上。

english: Remove the objective without touching the glass. Return the objective to its labelled drawer.
chinese: 如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。請將物鏡放回有相應標籤的抽屜。取出物鏡時請勿觸碰鏡片。

english: Please use the show's style sheet for speaker labels. Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments.
chinese: 傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前，須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。說話者的姓名標示請參照節目格式指引。

english: The school check uses the performance seating plan. Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime. Instrument cases stay in the green room during rehearsal.
chinese: 外來樂手如已完成場地試音，可豁免學校試音，但其間曾更換樂器者除外。彩排期間，樂器盒須留在後台休息室。學校試音按演出座位表安排。

english: Only completed matches count towards ladder points. The scoreboard is updated on Fridays.
chinese: 未打完的比賽亦計入排名賽積分。計分板逢星期五更新。

english: In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Each cassette should be logged by its title. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the first code in the log key.
chinese: 每盒錄音帶須按其標題登記。紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第一個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: Return the temporary lunch card in person.
chinese: 臨時午膳卡須親身交還。

english: Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file. Each submission is assigned a project reference. The review panel meets monthly.
chinese: 每份呈交的文件均獲編配項目參考編號。評審小組每月開會。附交的插圖及隨附函件均須退回寄件人。

english: Use the 12 mm screw to join the binder covers.
chinese: 請用12毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。

english: Each member may bring two guests on the walk. The route description includes facilities along the way.
chinese: 路線介紹列出沿途設施。每名會員可攜同一名賓客參加步行導賞。

english: Only completed matches count towards ladder points. A fresh ladder is drawn up each term.
chinese: 每學期均會重新編製排名表。只有打完的比賽才計入排名賽積分。

english: The lawn can reopen after seeding, except in the marked section beside the shelter. The boundary is marked with low timber posts.
chinese: 草地完成播種後可重開，但涼亭旁有標記的部分除外。邊界設有矮木柱作標記。

english: Urgent safety calls continue to go straight to the response team. For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water after supply has resumed. Operators can check the restoration time in the repair log.
chinese: 水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。接線人員可在維修紀錄查閱恢復供水時間。緊急安全求助仍直接轉介應變小組。

english: The briefing recording may be released with the speaker's consent. Members of the public may submit written follow-up questions.
chinese: 取得講者同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。市民可其後以書面提交跟進問題。

english: Number the drafts in chronological order. Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review.
chinese: 完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾一個學期。請按日期先後為各份草稿編號。

english: Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner moves before you release the inner guide. The corner should sit flush against both sides of the jig. Do not apply glue while checking the fit.
chinese: 角位應貼合定位夾具的兩邊。檢查接合位置時請勿塗膠。放開內導件後，如角位仍會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。

english: Apply two light coats to the practice sketch. Work with the sketch laid flat.
chinese: 請將素描平放後才處理。請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。

english: The account shows the sequence of transfers. If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds. The payment provider receives the reference number by secure message.
chinese: 如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷首次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理第二次轉移。參考編號會以保安訊息發給付款服務商。帳戶會顯示各次轉移的先後次序。

english: The briefing recording may be released with the speaker's consent.
chinese: 取得講者同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。

english: An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available. The seminar is recorded for students who miss the live session. The attendance system keeps a separate list for each session.
chinese: 研討會設錄影，方便未能出席的學生。考勤系統會分別保存每節活動的出席名單。退出發布的選擇同時適用於影片及文字記錄。

english: The payment provider receives the reference number by secure message. If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds. The canteen may record the case without immediately changing the balance.
chinese: 如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷首次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理第二次轉移。飯堂可先登記事件，毋須即時調整結餘。參考編號會以保安訊息發給付款服務商。

english: Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts. Keep bags outside the playing area.
chinese: 請把球袋放在比賽範圍以外。選拔試場地禁止穿着黑底鞋。

english: If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake. The register records the actual start of each candidate's session. A written confirmation will be issued for each approved retake.
chinese: 登記冊會記錄每名考生的實際開考時間。重考申請獲批後，考生會收到書面確認。如監考員缺席，只有已開始應考的學生可申請重考。

english: Contact the booking volunteer before the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot. The hall calendar shows provisional requests in grey. You will receive your own booking reference if the transfer goes through.
chinese: 會堂日曆以灰色標示暫定申請。轉讓成功後，你會獲發自己的預約編號。原租用者確認釋出時段後，方可聯絡處理預約的義工。

english: Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts. A coach will direct players to their assigned court.
chinese: 教練會指示球員前往所屬球場。選拔試場地禁止穿着黑底鞋。

english: Print the correction on the first page of the next issue. Notify the original author when the correction is ready.
chinese: 更正啟事須刊於下一期的首頁。更正稿擬備後，請通知原作者。

english: Return the handle to its parked position after servicing. Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session.
chinese: 每次保養後，須記錄潤滑劑的批次編號。保養後請將搖柄放回停放位置。

english: We will send a separate message when the transcript is ready. A volunteer keeps a list of the contributions received. The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group.
chinese: 義工會備存已收到的分享內容清單。故事分享小組保留錄音只供內部謄寫，並會向小組成員分享經編輯的文字稿。文字稿備妥後我們會另行通知。

english: A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area. Record the total number of accepted samples on the batch sheet.
chinese: 請在批次紀錄表填上獲接納的樣本總數。樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按撕裂樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。

english: The officer receiving the property signs the inventory. Store the items in a sealed container.
chinese: 遺物須存放於密封容器內。物品清單由發還遺物的人員簽署。

english: Each member may bring one guest on the walk. Name badges are available for both members and guests.
chinese: 每名會員可攜同兩名賓客參加步行導賞。會員和賓客均可領取姓名牌。

english: The image format is the same under both profiles. The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. For a public demonstration, enable the second profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through. The display technician checks the screen feed before people enter.
chinese: 兩個設定檔所用的影像格式相同。觀眾入場前，顯示設備技術員會檢查畫面訊號。第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第一個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。

english: In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the first code in the log key.
chinese: 紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第一個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: Use the preview to verify each row number. Export only verified rows that have no personal data. The export file includes a timestamp in its name.
chinese: 須匯出所有已核實的資料列，但包含個人資料的資料列不輸出備註欄內容。匯出檔案的名稱載有時間戳記。請在預覽中核對每個資料列編號。

english: A small supply of spare overshoes is available at the desk. Overshoes are required in the changing corridor.
chinese: 接待櫃檯備有少量鞋套供取用。進入更衣走廊須穿上鞋套。

english: One deposit is recorded for each jar. Pay the jar deposit by bank transfer.
chinese: 玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。每個玻璃瓶的按金會分開記錄。

english: Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place. Keep removed clips in the storage pouch.
chinese: 安裝後須拆除運輸固定夾，但固定可拆式層板的夾具除外。已拆除的夾具須放入收納袋。

english: Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime. Instrument cases stay in the green room during rehearsal. The school check uses the performance seating plan.
chinese: 彩排期間，樂器盒須留在後台休息室。學校試音按演出座位表安排。外來樂手如已完成場地試音，可豁免學校試音，但其間曾更換樂器者除外。

english: For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water before supply has resumed. Urgent safety calls continue to go straight to the response team. Operators can check the restoration time in the repair log.
chinese: 水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。緊急安全求助仍直接轉介應變小組。接線人員可在維修紀錄查閱恢復供水時間。

english: Keep paper receipts in date order. The petty cash float is capped at HK$400.
chinese: 零用現金備用額上限為港幣400元。紙本收據須按日期順序存放。

english: Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. The desk volunteer checks the voucher record before confirming eligibility. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed.
chinese: 櫃檯義工會先查閱券的紀錄，再確認資格。藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用藍色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。

english: Remove the adhesive strip before folding the insert. Place the insert inside the larger carton.
chinese: 請把內襯放入較大的紙箱內。摺疊內襯前，請先移除黏貼帶。

english: The installation sheet has a diagram of the clip locations. Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place. Check that the cabinet is level before filling it.
chinese: 安裝說明附有夾具位置圖。安裝後須拆除運輸固定夾，但固定可拆式層板的夾具除外。放入物品前須確認展示櫃放置平穩。

english: Racquets can be borrowed from the sports office. Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts.
chinese: 體育組辦事處備有球拍供借用。選拔試場地禁止穿着黑底鞋。

english: Requests are handled through the guidance office. A student may preview the factual information on a reference form, but the teacher's comments remain confidential. The receiving institution keeps its own copy of the form.
chinese: 學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料，但教師評語仍屬保密。接收院校會自行存檔。申請由升學輔導辦事處處理。

english: The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses. An asterisk indicates a tied score.
chinese: 同分以星號標示。計分板只顯示排名首五名的社隊分數。

english: The school check uses the performance seating plan. Instrument cases stay in the green room during rehearsal. Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime. There is a separate sound check at the performance venue.
chinese: 學校試音按演出座位表安排。彩排期間，樂器盒須留在後台休息室。外來樂手如已完成場地試音，即使其間曾更換樂器，亦可豁免學校試音。演出場地另設試音環節。

english: The piano's dimensions should be included on the inventory. The donor arranges delivery to the community room.
chinese: 捐贈者須安排把鋼琴送至社區活動室。清冊應列明鋼琴的尺寸。

english: Case officers may refer records to the review team. If a caller disputes the transcript, retain the caller's written correction alongside the original. Record the date on which the original transcript was shared.
chinese: 請記錄發出原有文字記錄的日期。個案主任可把紀錄轉交覆核小組。

english: Wrap each donated violin bow separately. Volunteers can pick up packing materials from the storeroom.
chinese: 每支捐贈的小提琴弓均須獨立包裹。義工可到儲物室領取包裝物料。

english: Consent records are held by the year coordinator. The digital catalogue uses the same showcase rules. When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work and all anonymous remarks from the showcase. The showcase includes coursework and written comments.
chinese: 同意紀錄由年級統籌主任保管。電子圖錄適用相同的展示規則。學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。展覽包含學生習作及書面評語。

english: Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence. You will receive a confirmation email once the service is active.
chinese: 啟用電子函件服務須使用本期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。服務啟用後會發出確認電郵。

english: When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate their lead-guide token immediately and retain any observer token until the end of the current tour. The system sends a confirmation when a token is deactivated. Existing route bookings remain available to the replacement guide.
chinese: 通行憑證停用後，系統會發出確認通知。接任導賞員仍可使用已預約的路線時段。導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊通行憑證；觀察員通行憑證則保留至該次導賞完結。

english: Overshoes are required in the reception area instead. A small supply of spare overshoes is available at the desk.
chinese: 進入更衣走廊須穿上鞋套。接待櫃檯備有少量鞋套供取用。

english: Line the collection box with a paper bag. Remove any elastic bands around the newspapers.
chinese: 請取下綑着報紙的橡皮圈。請在收集箱內鋪上紙袋。

english: The register records the actual start of each candidate's session. If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake. A written confirmation will be issued for each approved retake.
chinese: 如監考員缺席，只有未能開始應考的學生可申請重考。重考申請獲批後，考生會收到書面確認。登記冊會記錄每名考生的實際開考時間。

english: Keep the instrument cover with the drum itself. The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section B of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting.
chinese: 鼓罩須與鼓一同存放。清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊B欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。

english: There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection. You can track the request using the case number.
chinese: 首次申請渠務檢查須繳付港幣50元。可憑個案編號查詢進度。

english: Stand the pole tip-up to dry the lower shaft. Wipe mud from the ferrule after use.
chinese: 使用後請抹去杖頭套的泥污。請將手杖杖尖朝下直立，讓下節杖管風乾。

english: Permit holders can update their correspondence address online. The suspension decision is served by registered post.
chinese: 許可證持有人可在網上更新通訊地址。暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。

english: Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth. Report missing labels to the equipment librarian.
chinese: 請用乾棉布清潔凸字標籤。如有標籤遺失，請通知器材管理員。

english: There is a separate sound check at the performance venue. Instrument cases stay in the green room during rehearsal. Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime. The school check uses the performance seating plan.
chinese: 演出場地另設試音環節。彩排期間，樂器盒須留在後台休息室。外來樂手如已完成場地試音，可豁免學校試音，但其間曾更換樂器者除外。學校試音按演出座位表安排。

english: Visitors may take handwritten notes during inspection. The register must remain in the inspection room.
chinese: 查閱登記冊時，訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。登記冊須留在查閱室內。

english: Please keep the space around the counter clear. Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter.
chinese: 請勿阻塞櫃檯一帶。將飲品單交到櫃檯前，請先填上桌號。

english: There is a separate sound check at the performance venue. The school check uses the performance seating plan. Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime.
chinese: 學校試音按演出座位表安排。外來樂手如已完成場地試音，可豁免學校試音，但其間曾更換樂器者除外。演出場地另設試音環節。

english: Export all verified rows, and suppress the notes column for rows with personal data. The export file includes a timestamp in its name.
chinese: 須匯出所有已核實的資料列，但包含個人資料的資料列不輸出備註欄內容。匯出檔案的名稱載有時間戳記。

english: Set the camera to record RAW files for the lighting exercise.
chinese: 進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存RAW檔案。

english: The route description includes facilities along the way. Each member may bring one guest on the walk.
chinese: 每名會員可攜同一名賓客參加步行導賞。路線介紹列出沿途設施。

english: The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, except for participants already assigned a shuttle. A final route note will be shared before the event. Keep the event organiser's telephone number with you.
chinese: 如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者除外。活動前會發出最終路線通知。請隨身備存活動主辦人的電話號碼。

english: Keep photographs in removable sleeves. Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets.
chinese: 作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。相片須放在可拆式透明套內。

english: Attach the brace to the rear leg. Tighten the thumb screw by hand.
chinese: 請用手擰緊手擰螺絲。請將支撐桿接到後腳。

english: Push the latch inward to lower the trolley handle.
chinese: 向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。

english: The screening includes audio description. Ushers can help you find the accessible seating area.
chinese: 場務人員可指引你前往無障礙座位區。放映場次設有口述影像服務。

english: Remove the adhesive strip after folding the insert. The insert fits around the corners of the product.
chinese: 摺疊內襯前，請先移除黏貼帶。內襯套在產品的各個角位。

english: The booth keeps a printed working copy. Use the shared folder to file the rehearsal notes. Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script.
chinese: 彩排紀錄須存入共用資料夾。舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本後，才可修改場務提示表。控制室備有供工作使用的紙本。

english: Insert the artwork with the inked face up. Wipe the base plate clean between impressions.
chinese: 每次壓印後請抹乾淨底板。放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝下。

english: Speakers may suggest amendments to the edited text. The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group. A volunteer keeps a list of the contributions received.
chinese: 故事分享小組保留錄音只供內部謄寫，並會向小組成員分享經編輯的文字稿。義工會備存已收到的分享內容清單。講述者可就文字稿提出修訂建議。

english: The petty cash float is capped at HK$400. Keep paper receipts in date order.
chinese: 紙本收據須按日期順序存放。零用現金備用額上限為港幣450元。

english: We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it. The update form asks for a brief description of the proposed change. Please copy the current pin label into your message.
chinese: 地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認，便可更改。更新表要求簡述擬作的改動。請在訊息內抄錄現有地圖標記的標籤。

english: Contact the booking volunteer after the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot. Equipment requests are recorded on a separate form.
chinese: 器材申請另用表格記錄。原租用者確認釋出時段後，方可聯絡處理預約的義工。

english: Push the latch inward to lower the trolley handle. Do not rest your free hand on the hinge.
chinese: 向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。請勿將另一隻手放在鉸位上。

english: Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session. Keep cleaning materials in the maintenance cupboard.
chinese: 清潔物料請存放於保養用品櫃。每次保養後，須記錄潤滑劑的批次編號。

english: Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio. Name the recording after the reading passage.
chinese: 請以朗讀篇章的名稱為錄音檔案命名。每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。

english: Line the collection box with a paper bag.
chinese: 請在收集箱內鋪上紙袋。

english: Use the new meter's opening reading as the billing baseline. Both readings appear on the replacement record.
chinese: 更換紀錄載有兩個讀數。請以新水錶的起始讀數作為計費基準。

english: Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed. The desk volunteer checks the voucher record before confirming eligibility.
chinese: 櫃檯義工會先查閱券的紀錄，再確認資格。藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用藍色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。

english: The screening does not include audio description. A short discussion will follow the screening.
chinese: 放映完畢後會有簡短討論。放映場次設有口述影像服務。

english: The attendance system keeps a separate list for each session. An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available. Slides will be shared separately by the presenter.
chinese: 考勤系統會分別保存每節活動的出席名單。退出發布的選擇只適用於影片，文字記錄仍可供查閱。講者會另行分享投影片。

english: Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen. Describe the appearance of the sheen in the incident log.
chinese: 請在事故紀錄內描述油膜的外觀。請記錄首次發現油膜的時間。

english: Use a blank sheet from the calibration pack for each test. The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. When checking the repaired scanner, use the first profile in the test guide for the test scan.
chinese: 每次測試均須使用校準套件內的空白紙。第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第一個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: Each registered organisation has one vote on the mural shortlist. Samples of the colour palette are available at the exhibition.
chinese: 展覽現場備有色板樣本。每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投一票。

english: Remove the adhesive strip before folding the insert. The insert fits around the corners of the product.
chinese: 摺疊內襯前，請先移除黏貼帶。內襯套在產品的各個角位。

english: Seal the stall's cash pouch before handing it over.
chinese: 攤位交收現金袋前，須先將袋口封妥。

english: Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink.
chinese: 濕度指示卡有三格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。

english: Delete test scans when the check is complete. The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. When checking the repaired scanner, use the first profile in the test guide for the test scan.
chinese: 完成檢查後須刪除測試掃描檔案。第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第一個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand. The team will give the caretaker an updated visit list.
chinese: 如有單位未能接受檢查，只須為該單位另作安排，其他單位的預約維持原定時間。小組會向管理員提供更新後的到訪名單。

english: A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand. The team will give the caretaker an updated visit list. Leave enough space for the inspector to reach the shutoff valve.
chinese: 小組會向管理員提供更新後的到訪名單。請預留足夠空間，方便檢查人員接觸截流閥。如有單位未能接受檢查，該單位及其他單位的預約均須另作安排。

english: Use the sterile plastic bottle supplied with the sampling kit. Note any visible surface film in the field log.
chinese: 如水面有可見薄膜，請在實地紀錄簿註明。請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。

english: Do not apply glue while checking the fit. Keep the base of the jig clear of sawdust. Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner still moves after you release the inner guide.
chinese: 檢查接合位置時請勿塗膠。定位夾具底座不得積有木屑。放開內導件前，如角位會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。

english: The piano will be tuned after it arrives. The donor arranges delivery to the community room.
chinese: 鋼琴送抵後會安排調音。捐贈者須安排把鋼琴送至社區活動室。

english: A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present. Other seats can be used without a booking.
chinese: 其他座位毋須預約。陪同者只可在所陪同的讀者在場時，使用安靜樓層的預留座位。

english: Line the collection box with a plastic bag. Remove any elastic bands around the newspapers.
chinese: 請取下綑着報紙的橡皮圈。請在收集箱內鋪上紙袋。

english: Do not apply glue while checking the fit. Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner still moves after you release the inner guide. Keep the base of the jig clear of sawdust.
chinese: 檢查接合位置時請勿塗膠。放開內導件後，如角位仍會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。定位夾具底座不得積有木屑。

english: Return unused strands in the original sleeve. The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days.
chinese: 紗線樣本可免費借用十天。未用完的紗線須放回原有封套交還。

english: Enter the water after the first whistle. Leave your towel on the poolside rack.
chinese: 請把毛巾放在池邊架上。第二下哨聲響起後方可下水。

english: Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim. Keep a copy of the claim for your own records.
chinese: 請自行保存申請表副本。申請發還款項時須提交分項發票。

english: The installation sheet has a diagram of the clip locations. Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place.
chinese: 安裝後須拆除運輸固定夾，但固定可拆式層板的夾具除外。安裝說明附有夾具位置圖。

english: The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast. Keep the unedited track in the production folder.
chinese: 請在製作資料夾保留未經剪輯的音軌。錄音播出前須取得訪問者同意。

english: Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed. Keep any redeemed voucher number for your records.
chinese: 藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用藍色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。請自行保存已兌換的券號。

english: Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth. Support the globe by its base while working.
chinese: 清潔時請扶穩地球儀底座。請用乾棉布清潔凸字標籤。

english: Each pupil may check out up to three dictionaries at once. Some dictionaries come with a pronunciation guide.
chinese: 部分字典附有發音指南。每名學生同時最多可借用兩本字典。

english: A short discussion will follow the screening. The screening includes audio description.
chinese: 放映場次設有口述影像服務。放映完畢後會有簡短討論。

english: You will receive a confirmation email once the service is active. Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence.
chinese: 服務啟用後會發出確認電郵。啟用電子函件服務須使用本期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。

english: Use the sterile plastic bottle supplied with the sampling kit. Keep the filled bottle cool during transport.
chinese: 裝妥樣本後，運送時須保持樣本瓶低溫。請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。

english: Scrap metal goes into a separate container. Return serviceable road studs to stores before the inspection team signs the recovery sheet. Record the location of each recovered item.
chinese: 狀況良好的路面反光標只能在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄後送回物料倉。請記錄每件回收物品的位置。廢金屬須放入另一容器。

english: Assign the left pedal to page back.
chinese: 請將左踏板設定為翻至上一頁。

english: The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. When checking the repaired scanner, use the first profile in the test guide for the test scan.
chinese: 第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第一個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: Please leave the consultation materials on the reading table after use. Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site, but copies may only be released with written permission.
chinese: 訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，但須有書面許可方可取得副本。用畢請把諮詢資料留在閱覽桌上。

english: Senders may request confirmation of receipt. The review panel meets monthly. Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file.
chinese: 評審小組每月開會。附交的插圖須退回寄件人，隨附函件則留在項目檔案。寄件人可要求確認收件。

english: Members may add removable notes to the loan copy. A large-print copy is available on request.
chinese: 會員可直接在借閱本上書寫。可按需要索取大字版本。

english: Wash and dry your hands before handling a new card. Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink.
chinese: 觸碰新指示卡前，請洗手並把雙手抹乾。濕度指示卡有三格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。

english: Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth. Check the labels for lifting edges after cleaning.
chinese: 清潔完畢後請檢查標籤邊緣有否翹起。請用乾棉布清潔凸字標籤。

english: The secretary will confirm any change of address before updating the register. The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, provided that both renew together.
chinese: 同住的兄弟姊妹如一同續會，社團可豁免第二人的會費。秘書會先確認地址變更，再更新會員名冊。

english: The briefing recording may be released with the speaker's consent. The recording covers the question period.
chinese: 錄音涵蓋答問環節。取得講者同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。

english: Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation. The invoice should identify the model where available.
chinese: 如型號可查，發票應列出型號。以資助金購買的器材歸撥款部門所有。

english: Keep the instrument cover with the drum itself. The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section A of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting. The receptionist confirms which items have been returned.
chinese: 鼓罩須與鼓一同存放。接待員會確認已交還的物品。清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊B欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。

english: The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings. A supervisor will photograph the site after reinstatement.
chinese: 改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除，臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。還原現場後，督導人員會拍攝現場相片。

english: Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review.
chinese: 完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾一個學期。

english: Each pupil may check out up to two dictionaries at once. Write the accession number on the borrowing slip.
chinese: 請在借用單填寫館藏編號。每名學生同時最多可借用兩本字典。

english: Captains may inspect the updated register after the match. A note should record when the substitute entered the pitch. The referee flags an unauthorised substitute, and the tournament secretary corrects the team sheet.
chinese: 紀錄應註明替補球員上場的時間。未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。賽後隊長可查閱已更新的紀錄。

english: Keep a copy of the claim for your own records. Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim.
chinese: 申請發還款項時須提交分項發票。請自行保存申請表副本。

english: Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments. The host will send the final transcript to the guest. Spelling corrections can be added in the shared document.
chinese: 傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前，須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。主持人會把最終文字稿交給嘉賓。可在共用文件加入拼寫更正。

english: Unused meal credits remain on your regular account. Return the temporary lunch card in person.
chinese: 未使用的午膳金額仍存於原有帳戶。臨時午膳卡須親身交還。

english: Only completed matches count towards ladder points. Both players should initial the record sheet.
chinese: 兩名球員均應在賽果紀錄表上簡簽。只有打完的比賽才計入排名賽積分。

english: Label the dividers along the outside edge. Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets.
chinese: 作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。請在分隔頁的外側邊緣加上標籤。

english: Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice. Clean liners are stocked at the reception desk.
chinese: 內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌，方可投放到堆肥收集系統。接待處備有清潔的內袋。

english: Wrap the donated violin bows as one bundle. The receiving school will acknowledge delivery by email.
chinese: 接收學校會以電郵確認收貨。每支捐贈的小提琴弓均須獨立包裹。

english: The case reference appears at the top of each record. If a caller disputes the transcript, retain the caller's written correction alongside the original. Case officers may refer records to the review team.
chinese: 每份紀錄的頂部均載有個案編號。如來電者對通話文字記錄有異議，須將來電者提交的書面更正與原文一併保存。個案主任可把紀錄轉交覆核小組。

english: Clean liners are stocked at the reception desk. Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice. Volunteers empty collection points at the end of the event.
chinese: 內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌，方可投放到堆肥收集系統。活動完結時由義工清空收集點。接待處備有清潔的內袋。

english: Keep the signed form in the works file. Scrap metal goes into a separate container. Return serviceable road studs to stores before the inspection team signs the recovery sheet.
chinese: 已簽署的表格須存放於工程檔案。廢金屬須放入另一容器。狀況良好的路面反光標只能在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄後送回物料倉。

english: The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. For a public demonstration, enable the second profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through. The image format is the same under both profiles. The display technician checks the screen feed before people enter.
chinese: 第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。兩個設定檔所用的影像格式相同。觀眾入場前，顯示設備技術員會檢查畫面訊號。

english: Volunteers may sign out after packing the stall equipment. Seal the stall's cash pouch before handing it over.
chinese: 義工收妥攤位用品後可簽退。攤位交收現金袋前，須先將袋口封妥。

english: If the storage sleeve feels damp, replace the sleeve before putting the objective away. Remove the objective without touching the glass.
chinese: 取出物鏡時請勿觸碰鏡片。如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。

english: The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. Keep the instrument cover with the drum itself. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section B of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting.
chinese: 鼓罩須與鼓一同存放。清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊B欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。

english: Existing route bookings remain available to the replacement guide. When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate their lead-guide token immediately and retain any observer token until the end of the current tour. The system sends a confirmation when a token is deactivated.
chinese: 導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊通行憑證；觀察員通行憑證則保留至該次導賞完結。通行憑證停用後，系統會發出確認通知。接任導賞員仍可使用已預約的路線時段。

english: The referee flags an unauthorised substitute, and the tournament secretary corrects the team sheet. Keep the original team sheet with the match report. Captains may inspect the updated register after the match.
chinese: 未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。請把原有隊伍名單與比賽報告一併保存。賽後隊長可查閱已更新的紀錄。

english: Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner still moves after you release the inner guide. Keep the base of the jig clear of sawdust.
chinese: 定位夾具底座不得積有木屑。放開內導件後，如角位仍會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。

english: Each registered organisation has one vote on the mural shortlist. The shortlisted proposals identify both the site and the artist.
chinese: 入圍方案均列明地點及藝術家姓名。每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投一票。

english: Both players should initial the record sheet. Only completed matches count towards ladder points.
chinese: 只有打完的比賽才計入排名賽積分。兩名球員均應在賽果紀錄表上簡簽。

english: The showcase includes coursework and written comments. Consent records are held by the year coordinator. When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work from the showcase but retain anonymous remarks unless the remarks identify them.
chinese: 同意紀錄由年級統籌主任保管。學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。展覽包含學生習作及書面評語。

english: The export file includes a timestamp in its name. Export all verified rows, and suppress the notes column for rows with personal data. The master worksheet remains unchanged by the export.
chinese: 須匯出所有已核實的資料列，但包含個人資料的資料列不輸出備註欄內容。匯出資料不會改動主工作表。匯出檔案的名稱載有時間戳記。

english: Only bring the item listed on the booking form. You can transfer your repair appointment to another household member.
chinese: 你可把維修預約轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。請只帶同預約表所列的物品。

english: For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water after supply has resumed. The call record distinguishes colour complaints from pressure complaints. Operators can check the restoration time in the repair log.
chinese: 水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。來電紀錄會區分水色和水壓投訴。接線人員可在維修紀錄查閱恢復供水時間。

english: Only completed matches count towards ladder points. The scoreboard is updated on Fridays.
chinese: 只有打完的比賽才計入排名賽積分。計分板逢星期五更新。

english: You can transfer your repair appointment to another household member. Only bring the item listed on the booking form.
chinese: 請只帶同預約表所列的物品。維修預約不可轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。

english: The lawn can reopen after seeding, including the marked section beside the shelter. The boundary is marked with low timber posts. The grounds team will inspect seed growth each week.
chinese: 邊界設有矮木柱作標記。園務小組會每周檢查種子生長情況。草地完成播種後可重開，但涼亭旁有標記的部分除外。

english: Class groups are listed separately. Students may use their preferred first name in the yearbook.
chinese: 學生可在畢業紀念冊使用自己選用的名字。各班的名單會分開刊載。

english: A copy of the inventory is filed with the case papers. The officer receiving the property signs the inventory.
chinese: 物品清單的副本會與個案文件一併存檔。物品清單由接收遺物的人員簽署。

english: The canteen may record the case without immediately changing the balance. If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds. The account shows the sequence of transfers. The payment provider receives the reference number by secure message.
chinese: 如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷第二次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理首次轉移。帳戶會顯示各次轉移的先後次序。參考編號會以保安訊息發給付款服務商。飯堂可先登記事件，毋須即時調整結餘。

english: Use a ruler to check the first printed label. Set the right margin to 8 mm before printing the labels.
chinese: 列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為8毫米。請用間尺核對第一張已列印的標籤。

english: If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds. The account shows the sequence of transfers. The canteen may record the case without immediately changing the balance.
chinese: 如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷首次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理第二次轉移。帳戶會顯示各次轉移的先後次序。飯堂可先登記事件，毋須即時調整結餘。

english: Other seats can be used without a booking. Please keep phone conversations outside the quiet floor. A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present.
chinese: 請離開安靜樓層後才通電話。陪同者只可在所陪同的讀者在場時，使用安靜樓層的預留座位。其他座位毋須預約。

english: Flatten empty cartons before placing them in the collection cage. Do not put fish waste in the carton cage.
chinese: 魚類廢物不得放入紙箱回收籠。空紙箱放入回收籠前，須先壓平。

english: The cover may be reused from an earlier project. Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets.
chinese: 封面可沿用以往專題研習的封面。作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。

english: Each member may bring one guest on the walk.
chinese: 每名會員可攜同一名賓客參加步行導賞。

english: Instrument cases stay in the green room during rehearsal. Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime. There is a separate sound check at the performance venue. The school check uses the performance seating plan.
chinese: 外來樂手如已完成場地試音，即使其間曾更換樂器，亦可豁免學校試音。演出場地另設試音環節。學校試音按演出座位表安排。彩排期間，樂器盒須留在後台休息室。

english: Use the 12 mm screw to join the binder covers. Keep the bag of spare fixings in the cover pocket.
chinese: 請用12毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。請把備用配件放在封面內袋。

english: The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group. Speakers may suggest amendments to the edited text. We will send a separate message when the transcript is ready.
chinese: 故事分享小組保留錄音只供內部謄寫，並會向小組成員分享經編輯的文字稿。講述者可就文字稿提出修訂建議。文字稿備妥後我們會另行通知。

english: Residents may appoint someone to open the door for them. Leave enough space for the inspector to reach the shutoff valve. A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand.
chinese: 請預留足夠空間，方便檢查人員接觸截流閥。如有單位未能接受檢查，只須為該單位另作安排，其他單位的預約維持原定時間。住戶可委託他人代為開門。

english: Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink. The inspection sheet records the date of installation.
chinese: 檢查表載有安裝日期。濕度指示卡有三格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。

english: Seal the stall's cash pouch before handing it over. Include the stall name on the collection slip.
chinese: 請在交收單填上攤位名稱。攤位交收現金袋前，須先將袋口封妥。

english: Use the new meter's opening reading as the billing baseline.
chinese: 請以新水錶的起始讀數作為計費基準。

english: The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group. Speakers may suggest amendments to the edited text. A volunteer keeps a list of the contributions received.
chinese: 講述者可就文字稿提出修訂建議。義工會備存已收到的分享內容清單。故事分享小組會向小組成員分享錄音及經編輯的文字稿。

english: Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim.
chinese: 申請發還款項時須提交分項發票。

english: Please leave the consultation materials on the reading table after use. Staff can help locate drawings by address. Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site and obtain copies without written permission.
chinese: 用畢請把諮詢資料留在閱覽桌上。職員可協助按地址找出圖則。訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，但須有書面許可方可取得副本。

english: Instrument cases stay in the green room during rehearsal. Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime. There is a separate sound check at the performance venue.
chinese: 彩排期間，樂器盒須留在後台休息室。外來樂手如已完成場地試音，可豁免學校試音，但其間曾更換樂器者除外。演出場地另設試音環節。

english: Return the temporary lunch card by internal mail. Write your student number on the lending slip.
chinese: 請在借用單上填寫學生編號。臨時午膳卡須親身交還。

english: The grounds team will inspect seed growth each week. The shelter itself remains available. The lawn can reopen after seeding, except in the marked section beside the shelter.
chinese: 園務小組會每周檢查種子生長情況。涼亭照常開放。草地完成播種後可重開，包括涼亭旁有標記的部分。

english: Members may add removable notes to the loan copy. A large-print copy is available on request.
chinese: 會員可在借閱本貼上可移除的便條。可按需要索取大字版本。

english: The clearance certificate remains valid for six months after issue. An inspector can explain the next steps to the tenant.
chinese: 合格證明書自簽發日起十二個月內有效。檢查人員可向租戶解釋後續程序。

english: The officer releasing the property signs the inventory. A copy of the inventory is filed with the case papers.
chinese: 物品清單由接收遺物的人員簽署。物品清單的副本會與個案文件一併存檔。

english: Volunteers empty collection points at the end of the event. Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice. Food scraps are sorted at the venue.
chinese: 活動完結時由義工清空收集點。內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌，方可投放到堆肥收集系統。廚餘須在會場分類。

english: The suspension decision is served by registered post. The decision letter states the reasons for suspension.
chinese: 決定書列明暫停許可證的理由。暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。

english: Senders may request confirmation of receipt. Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file. Each submission is assigned a project reference.
chinese: 附交的插圖及隨附函件均須退回寄件人。每份呈交的文件均獲編配項目參考編號。寄件人可要求確認收件。

english: The checkout log tracks which magnification is in use. If the storage sleeve feels damp, replace the sleeve before putting the objective away.
chinese: 如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。借用紀錄列明正在使用的放大倍率。

english: The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast. A short synopsis will precede each interview.
chinese: 每節訪問前會簡介訪問內容。錄音播出前須取得訪問者同意。

english: Check the labels for lifting edges after cleaning. Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth.
chinese: 請用乾棉布清潔凸字標籤。清潔完畢後請檢查標籤邊緣有否翹起。

english: Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts. Keep bags outside the playing area.
chinese: 請把球袋放在比賽範圍以外。選拔試場地可穿着黑底鞋。

english: Each registered organisation has two votes on the mural shortlist. The shortlisted proposals identify both the site and the artist.
chinese: 入圍方案均列明地點及藝術家姓名。每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投一票。

english: The case file contains contact and site details. The published list is updated after each review cycle. If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold the complainant's home address but a site address that identifies only the mural may be retained. The contractor can request a map for its work crew.
chinese: 個案檔案載有聯絡資料及場地資料。公眾名單會在每輪審核後更新。如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址，但可保留只用作識別壁畫位置的地址。承辦商可索取地圖供工作隊使用。

english: Post each pronunciation recording to the class feed. Use headphones when reviewing recordings in class.
chinese: 在課堂上重聽錄音時，請戴上耳機。每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。

english: Operators can check the restoration time in the repair log. For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water after supply has resumed. Urgent safety calls continue to go straight to the response team.
chinese: 水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水前報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。緊急安全求助仍直接轉介應變小組。接線人員可在維修紀錄查閱恢復供水時間。

english: You will receive your own booking reference if the transfer goes through. Equipment requests are recorded on a separate form. Contact the booking volunteer after the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot.
chinese: 轉讓成功後，你會獲發自己的預約編號。器材申請另用表格記錄。須在原租用者確認釋出時段前聯絡處理預約的義工。

english: Members may add removable notes to the loan copy. Please mark the chapter you want to discuss.
chinese: 請標示你希望討論的章節。會員可在借閱本貼上可移除的便條。

english: Quote the title of the affected article. Print the correction on the first page of the next issue.
chinese: 更正啟事須刊於下一期的首頁。請引述有關文章的標題。

english: Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner still moves after you release the inner guide. The corner should sit flush against both sides of the jig.
chinese: 放開內導件後，如角位仍會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。角位應貼合定位夾具的兩邊。

english: There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection. Provide a description of the blockage on the request form.
chinese: 請在申請表說明淤塞情況。首次申請渠務檢查毋須繳費。

english: The interpreter must be at least 18 years old. The interpreter should arrive with the parties.
chinese: 傳譯員應與各方一同到場。傳譯員須年滿18歲。

english: A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area. Keep the same heat setting while comparing samples.
chinese: 樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按撕裂樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。比較樣本時須維持相同的加熱設定。

english: A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Keep the same heat setting while comparing samples. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area.
chinese: 比較樣本時須維持相同的加熱設定。樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按撕裂樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。

english: Operators can check the restoration time in the repair log. For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water after supply has resumed. The call record distinguishes colour complaints from pressure complaints.
chinese: 接線人員可在維修紀錄查閱恢復供水時間。水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。來電紀錄會區分水色和水壓投訴。

english: Spare parts are subject to availability. You can transfer your repair appointment to another household member.
chinese: 你可把維修預約轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。零件供應視乎存貨而定。

english: Pay the jar deposit by bank transfer. You can use your usual member number on the order.
chinese: 玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。訂購時可沿用原有會員編號。

english: Mentors are matched to students by field of interest. Participants will be given a list of suggested discussion topics.
chinese: 校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。參加者會收到一份建議討論題目清單。

english: Use the old meter's closing reading as the billing baseline. Both readings appear on the replacement record.
chinese: 更換紀錄載有兩個讀數。請以新水錶的起始讀數作為計費基準。

english: Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime. There is a separate sound check at the performance venue. Instrument cases stay in the green room during rehearsal.
chinese: 外來樂手如已完成場地試音，可豁免學校試音，但其間曾更換樂器者除外。演出場地另設試音環節。彩排期間，樂器盒須留在後台休息室。

english: Record the total number of accepted samples on the batch sheet. A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area.
chinese: 請在批次紀錄表填上獲接納的樣本總數。樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按撕裂樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。

english: Assign the left pedal to page back. Keep the configuration window open until the test ends.
chinese: 測試完結前，請保持設定視窗開啟。請將左踏板設定為翻至上一頁。

english: Teachers distribute the sketching sheets on the bus. Pupils may keep the spare sheets after the outing. If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first.
chinese: 活動結束後學生可保留剩餘的畫紙。學生借出影印本前，須先清除背面的個人筆記。老師會在旅遊車上派發速寫紙。

english: Enter the water after the first whistle. Tell the coach if you need to leave the session early.
chinese: 第二下哨聲響起後方可下水。如須提早離場，請通知教練。

english: A written confirmation will be issued for each approved retake. If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake. Any existing scripts must be handed to the exams officer.
chinese: 重考申請獲批後，考生會收到書面確認。如監考員缺席，只有未能開始應考的學生可申請重考。已派出的答題卷須交予考務主任。

english: Record any vegetation obscuring the wall surface. Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath above it.
chinese: 請從擋土牆上方的行人徑拍攝牆身。請記錄遮擋牆面的植物。

english: Each member may bring one guest on the walk. Name badges are available for both members and guests.
chinese: 每名會員可攜同一名賓客參加步行導賞。會員和賓客均可領取姓名牌。

english: Each member may bring one guest on the walk. Clothing suitable for the weather is recommended.
chinese: 建議穿着適合當日天氣的衣物。每名會員可攜同一名賓客參加步行導賞。

english: Keep the original team sheet with the match report. The referee flags an unauthorised substitute, and the tournament secretary corrects the team sheet. A note should record when the substitute entered the pitch.
chinese: 未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。紀錄應註明替補球員上場的時間。請把原有隊伍名單與比賽報告一併保存。

english: The host will send the final transcript to the guest. Please use the show's style sheet for speaker labels.
chinese: 主持人會把最終文字稿交給嘉賓。說話者的姓名標示請參照節目格式指引。傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前，須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。

english: In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the second code in the log key. Place the rewound cassettes in the padded box.
chinese: 已回帶的錄音帶請放進有襯墊的存放盒。紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第一個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: Candidates may bring their own sheet music. Set the keyboard to the acoustic piano sound for the practical assessment.
chinese: 實習評核須把電子琴設定為原聲鋼琴音色。應考學生可自備樂譜。

english: The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, provided that both renew together. A single receipt lists the names of all members covered by the payment. New members receive their own membership number.
chinese: 同住的兄弟姊妹如一同續會，社團可豁免第二人的會費。收據會列出同一筆款項所涵蓋的全體會員姓名。新會員各有獨立會員編號。

english: Each registered organisation has one vote on the mural shortlist. The panel will publish a summary of the feedback received.
chinese: 每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投一票。評審小組會公布收到的意見摘要。

english: The interpreter must be at least 18 years old. Tell the registry which language will be used for interpretation.
chinese: 請向登記處說明傳譯所用的語言。傳譯員須年滿21歲。

english: Attach the brace to the rear leg. Set the music stand on a level surface before working on it.
chinese: 操作前請把譜架放在平坦表面。請將支撐桿接到後腳。

english: Members of the public may submit written follow-up questions. The briefing recording may be released with the speaker's consent.
chinese: 市民可其後以書面提交跟進問題。取得講者同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。

english: Stand the pole tip-down to dry the lower shaft. Keep the wrist strap away from the drying surface.
chinese: 請避免腕帶接觸風乾用的表面。請將手杖杖尖朝上直立，讓下節杖管風乾。

english: The appointment reminder contains a map of the building. Notify the learning support coordinator if you cannot attend your appointment.
chinese: 預約提示附有大樓位置圖。如未能出席預約時段，請通知學習支援統籌主任。

english: Keep any redeemed voucher number for your records. Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed. The desk volunteer checks the voucher record before confirming eligibility.
chinese: 請自行保存已兌換的券號。櫃檯義工會先查閱券的紀錄，再確認資格。藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用黃色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。

english: Return serviceable road studs to stores only after the inspection team signs the recovery sheet. Record the location of each recovered item.
chinese: 狀況良好的路面反光標只能在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄後送回物料倉。請記錄每件回收物品的位置。

english: A note should record when the substitute entered the pitch. The referee flags an unauthorised substitute, and the tournament secretary corrects the team sheet. Captains may inspect the updated register after the match.
chinese: 紀錄應註明替補球員上場的時間。未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。賽後隊長可查閱已更新的紀錄。

english: Overshoes are required in the changing corridor. A staff member will check the corridor before each session.
chinese: 職員會在每節活動開始前檢查走廊。須在接待處穿上鞋套。

english: The shortlisted proposals identify both the site and the artist. Each registered organisation has one vote on the mural shortlist.
chinese: 每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投一票。入圍方案均列明地點及藝術家姓名。

english: Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath above it.
chinese: 請從擋土牆上方的行人徑拍攝牆身。

english: Tighten the thumb screw by hand. Attach the brace to the rear leg.
chinese: 請將支撐桿接到後腳。請用手擰緊手擰螺絲。

english: If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first. The exhibition covers several periods of local history. Pupils may keep the spare sheets after the outing.
chinese: 展覽涵蓋本地歷史的不同時期。活動結束後學生可保留剩餘的畫紙。

english: Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter. The workshop ticket includes one drink.
chinese: 工作坊門票包括一杯飲品。將飲品單交到櫃檯前，請先填上桌號。

english: An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available. Slides will be shared separately by the presenter.
chinese: 講者會另行分享投影片。退出發布的選擇只適用於影片，文字記錄仍可供查閱。

english: State which project the expenditure relates to. Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim.
chinese: 申請發還款項時須提交分項發票。請說明開支所屬的項目。

english: Keep the configuration window open until the test ends. Assign the left pedal to page back.
chinese: 請將左踏板設定為翻至上一頁。測試完結前，請保持設定視窗開啟。

english: Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation. Keep a register of the items purchased.
chinese: 請備存購入器材的清冊。以資助金購買的器材歸撥款部門所有。

english: The receptionist confirms which items have been returned. The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section B of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting.
chinese: 接待員會確認已交還的物品。清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊B欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。

english: Attach the brace to the rear leg. The stand should support an empty folder during the first check.
chinese: 請將支撐桿接到前腳。首次檢查時，譜架應能承托一個空文件夾。

english: Wrap each donated violin bow separately. Check that the donation slip gives the donor's contact details.
chinese: 請核對捐贈單是否載有捐贈者的聯絡資料。每支捐贈的小提琴弓均須獨立包裹。

english: Apply one light coat to the practice sketch. Test the spray pattern on scrap paper.
chinese: 請先在廢紙上試噴，檢查噴霧形狀。請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。

english: If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake. Any existing scripts must be handed to the exams officer.
chinese: 已派出的答題卷須交予考務主任。如監考員缺席，只有未能開始應考的學生可申請重考。

english: The contractor can request a map for its work crew. If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold the complainant's home address but a site address that identifies only the mural may be retained. The published list is updated after each review cycle.
chinese: 如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址，但可保留只用作識別壁畫位置的地址。公眾名單會在每輪審核後更新。承辦商可索取地圖供工作隊使用。

english: Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets. Label the dividers along the outside edge.
chinese: 請在分隔頁的外側邊緣加上標籤。作品集的分隔頁須用膠膜覆面的卡紙。

english: Set the right margin to 6 mm before printing the labels. A preview appears on the printer screen.
chinese: 列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為8毫米。預覽會顯示在打印機的屏幕上。

english: Keep a register of the items purchased. Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation.
chinese: 以資助金購買的器材歸受資助機構所有。請備存購入器材的清冊。

english: Use the ledger to record the purpose of each purchase. The petty cash float is capped at HK$400.
chinese: 請在帳簿記錄每項購買的用途。零用現金備用額上限為港幣400元。

english: Set the camera to record RAW files for the lighting exercise. The memory cards may be collected from the technician.
chinese: 進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存RAW檔案。記憶卡可向技術員領取。

english: The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. When checking the repaired scanner, use the first profile in the test guide for the test scan. Use a blank sheet from the calibration pack for each test.
chinese: 每次測試均須使用校準套件內的空白紙。第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第一個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter. Suitable cups are available for participants who need easy-grip handles.
chinese: 如需容易握持的杯柄，可索取合適的杯。將飲品單交到櫃檯前，請先填上桌號。

english: The call record distinguishes colour complaints from pressure complaints. Urgent safety calls continue to go straight to the response team. For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water after supply has resumed.
chinese: 緊急安全求助仍直接轉介應變小組。水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。來電紀錄會區分水色和水壓投訴。

english: The published list is updated after each review cycle. If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold the complainant's home address but a site address that identifies only the mural may be retained. The case file contains contact and site details.
chinese: 公眾名單會在每輪審核後更新。如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址，但可保留只用作識別壁畫位置的地址。個案檔案載有聯絡資料及場地資料。

english: The case file contains contact and site details. If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold the complainant's home address but a site address that identifies only the mural may be retained. The contractor can request a map for its work crew.
chinese: 如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址，但可保留只用作識別壁畫位置的地址。承辦商可索取地圖供工作隊使用。個案檔案載有聯絡資料及場地資料。

english: Remove the plastic holder before handing back the card. Return the temporary lunch card in person.
chinese: 臨時午膳卡須親身交還。交還午膳卡前，請取下膠套。

english: Wrap each donated violin bow separately. Volunteers can pick up packing materials from the storeroom.
chinese: 捐贈的小提琴弓須綑成一束包裹。義工可到儲物室領取包裝物料。

english: Return the temporary lunch card by internal mail. Unused meal credits remain on your regular account.
chinese: 臨時午膳卡須親身交還。未使用的午膳金額仍存於原有帳戶。

english: The review panel meets monthly. Senders may request confirmation of receipt. Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file.
chinese: 評審小組每月開會。寄件人可要求確認收件。附交的插圖及隨附函件均須退回寄件人。

english: Consent records are held by the year coordinator. When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work from the showcase but retain anonymous remarks unless the remarks identify them. The digital catalogue uses the same showcase rules.
chinese: 學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。電子圖錄適用相同的展示規則。同意紀錄由年級統籌主任保管。

english: A preview appears on the printer screen. Set the right margin to 8 mm before printing the labels.
chinese: 預覽會顯示在打印機的屏幕上。列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為8毫米。

english: A student may preview the factual information on a reference form, but the teacher's comments remain confidential. Requests are handled through the guidance office. The receiving institution keeps its own copy of the form.
chinese: 申請由升學輔導辦事處處理。接收院校會自行存檔。學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料及教師評語。

english: Seal the stall's cash pouch before handing it over. Volunteers may sign out after packing the stall equipment.
chinese: 攤位交收現金袋前，須先將袋口封妥。義工收妥攤位用品後可簽退。

english: The donor arranges delivery to the community room. The piano's dimensions should be included on the inventory.
chinese: 清冊應列明鋼琴的尺寸。社區活動室管理員須安排到捐贈者處收取鋼琴。

english: The map editor checks for duplicate locations. We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it. Please copy the current pin label into your message.
chinese: 地圖編輯人員會檢查是否有重複地點。地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認，便可更改。請在訊息內抄錄現有地圖標記的標籤。

english: The café meeting point is the same for both routes. The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, except for participants already assigned a shuttle. Keep the event organiser's telephone number with you.
chinese: 兩條路線的集合地點均為同一間咖啡店。如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者除外。請隨身備存活動主辦人的電話號碼。

english: The memory cards may be collected from the technician. Set the camera to record RAW files for the lighting exercise.
chinese: 記憶卡可向技術員領取。進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存RAW檔案。

english: Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site, but copies may only be released with written permission. Staff can help locate drawings by address.
chinese: 職員可協助按地址找出圖則。訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，但須有書面許可方可取得副本。

english: In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the first code in the log key. Place the rewound cassettes in the padded box.
chinese: 已回帶的錄音帶請放進有襯墊的存放盒。紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第一個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: Visitors may take handwritten notes during inspection.
chinese: 查閱登記冊時，訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。

english: The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, provided that both renew together. A single receipt lists the names of all members covered by the payment.
chinese: 同住的兄弟姊妹如一同續會，社團可豁免第二人的會費。收據會列出同一筆款項所涵蓋的全體會員姓名。

english: The guard will enter the remote's number in the issue log. Only the registered resident may collect the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may return it. Notify the management office if the remote stops working.
chinese: 借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶領取，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可歸還。如遙控器失靈，請通知管理處。保安員會在借出紀錄簿填寫遙控器編號。

english: Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed. Original files remain in the restricted research folder.
chinese: 只有在刪除坐標後，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。原始檔案會保留在限制存取的研究資料夾。

english: The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section B of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting. The receptionist confirms which items have been returned. Keep the instrument cover with the drum itself.
chinese: 接待員會確認已交還的物品。鼓罩須與鼓一同存放。清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊A欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。

english: Use the 12 mm screw to join the binder covers. Make sure the punched holes align with the spacer.
chinese: 請確保打好的孔與墊片對齊。請用12毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。

english: Enter the water after the second whistle. Leave your towel on the poolside rack.
chinese: 請把毛巾放在池邊架上。第二下哨聲響起後方可下水。

english: Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file. Senders may request confirmation of receipt.
chinese: 寄件人可要求確認收件。附交的插圖須退回寄件人，隨附函件則留在項目檔案。

english: The suspension decision is served by registered post. Officers retain a copy in the permit file.
chinese: 人員會在許可證檔案內保留副本。暫停許可證的決定以平郵送達。

english: Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed. The caption may identify the species.
chinese: 相片說明可註明物種。只有在刪除坐標後，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。

english: Assign the left pedal to page back. Check the pedal's action in the test document.
chinese: 請在測試文件中檢查踏板功能。請將左踏板設定為翻至上一頁。

english: We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it. Please copy the current pin label into your message.
chinese: 請在訊息內抄錄現有地圖標記的標籤。地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認，便可更改。

english: Teachers distribute the sketching sheets on the bus. If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first. The exhibition covers several periods of local history.
chinese: 展覽涵蓋本地歷史的不同時期。老師會在旅遊車上派發速寫紙。

english: There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection. Provide a description of the blockage on the request form.
chinese: 請在申請表說明淤塞情況。首次申請渠務檢查須繳付港幣50元。

english: Delete test scans when the check is complete. The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. When checking the repaired scanner, use the first profile in the test guide for the test scan.
chinese: 完成檢查後須刪除測試掃描檔案。第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第二個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: Some dictionaries come with a pronunciation guide. Each pupil may check out up to two dictionaries at once.
chinese: 每名學生同時最多可借用兩本字典。部分字典附有發音指南。

english: Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen. The response team may request additional photographs.
chinese: 應變小組可要求提供更多相片。請記錄首次發現油膜的時間。

english: Residents may appoint someone to open the door for them. A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand. The team will give the caretaker an updated visit list.
chinese: 如有單位未能接受檢查，該單位及其他單位的預約均須另作安排。小組會向管理員提供更新後的到訪名單。住戶可委託他人代為開門。

english: The jar sizes are listed on the order form. Pay the jar deposit by bank transfer.
chinese: 玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。訂購表列有各款玻璃瓶的容量。

english: The clearance certificate remains valid for six months after issue. The certificate states the address of the unit.
chinese: 證明書列明單位地址。合格證明書自簽發日起六個月內有效。

english: Pupils may keep the spare sheets after the outing. Teachers distribute the sketching sheets on the bus.
chinese: 活動結束後學生可保留剩餘的畫紙。老師會在旅遊車上派發速寫紙。學生借出影印本前，須先清除背面的個人筆記。

english: A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand. Residents may appoint someone to open the door for them.
chinese: 住戶可委託他人代為開門。如有單位未能接受檢查，只須為該單位另作安排，其他單位的預約維持原定時間。

english: A written confirmation will be issued for each approved retake. Any existing scripts must be handed to the exams officer. If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake.
chinese: 重考申請獲批後，考生會收到書面確認。已派出的答題卷須交予考務主任。如監考員缺席，只有已開始應考的學生可申請重考。

english: Please leave the consultation materials on the reading table after use. Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site, but copies may only be released with written permission. Staff can help locate drawings by address.
chinese: 用畢請把諮詢資料留在閱覽桌上。訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，但須有書面許可方可取得副本。職員可協助按地址找出圖則。

english: You can use your usual member number on the order. Pay the jar deposit by bank transfer.
chinese: 訂購時可沿用原有會員編號。玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。

english: The petty cash float is capped at HK$400. Use the ledger to record the purpose of each purchase.
chinese: 零用現金備用額上限為港幣400元。請在帳簿記錄每項購買的用途。

english: A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present. A map identifies the reserved desks.
chinese: 陪同者只可在所陪同的讀者在場時，使用安靜樓層的預留座位。平面圖上標有預留書桌的位置。

english: The coach will distribute caps at the warm-up area. Enter the water after the second whistle.
chinese: 第二下哨聲響起後方可下水。教練會在熱身區派發泳帽。

english: A student may preview the factual information on a reference form, but the teacher's comments remain confidential. Requests are handled through the guidance office.
chinese: 學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料，但教師評語仍屬保密。申請由升學輔導辦事處處理。

english: New members receive their own membership number. The secretary will confirm any change of address before updating the register. The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, provided that both renew together.
chinese: 秘書會先確認地址變更，再更新會員名冊。同住的兄弟姊妹如一同續會，社團可豁免第二人的會費。新會員各有獨立會員編號。

english: The examiner should confirm the animal's sex before signing the record. Record the microchip number shown by the scanner.
chinese: 請記錄晶片掃描器所顯示的號碼。檢查人員應先核實動物性別，再簽署紀錄。

english: Students may use their preferred first name in the yearbook.
chinese: 學生可在畢業紀念冊使用自己選用的名字。

english: Return serviceable road studs to stores only after the inspection team signs the recovery sheet. Record the location of each recovered item. Keep the signed form in the works file.
chinese: 請記錄每件回收物品的位置。已簽署的表格須存放於工程檔案。狀況良好的路面反光標須在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄前送回物料倉。

english: The suspension decision is served by ordinary post. Permit holders can update their correspondence address online.
chinese: 暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。許可證持有人可在網上更新通訊地址。

english: Notify the management office if the remote stops working. The loan slip shows the temporary access period. Only the registered resident may collect the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may return it.
chinese: 如遙控器失靈，請通知管理處。借用單列明臨時通行的期限。借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶歸還，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可領取。

english: The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, including for participants already assigned a shuttle. A final route note will be shared before the event. The café meeting point is the same for both routes.
chinese: 活動前會發出最終路線通知。兩條路線的集合地點均為同一間咖啡店。如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者除外。

english: Print the correction on the first page of the next issue. Quote the title of the affected article.
chinese: 請引述有關文章的標題。更正啟事須刊於下一期的首頁。

english: Club members can flag duplicate images for the editor. The caption may identify the species. Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates are still attached.
chinese: 學會會員可標記重複相片，供編輯處理。相片說明可註明物種。只有在刪除坐標後，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。

english: Leave the platform empty while adjusting the handle. Push the latch inward to lower the trolley handle.
chinese: 向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。調整手柄時，平台上不得放置物件。

english: Wrap each donated violin bow separately.
chinese: 每支捐贈的小提琴弓均須獨立包裹。

english: Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place. Check that the cabinet is level before filling it.
chinese: 放入物品前須確認展示櫃放置平穩。安裝後須拆除運輸固定夾，但固定可拆式層板的夾具除外。

english: Keep removed clips in the storage pouch. Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place. The installation sheet has a diagram of the clip locations.
chinese: 安裝後須拆除運輸固定夾，但固定可拆式層板的夾具除外。安裝說明附有夾具位置圖。已拆除的夾具須放入收納袋。

english: The petty cash float is capped at HK$400. Use the ledger to record the purpose of each purchase.
chinese: 零用現金備用額上限為港幣450元。請在帳簿記錄每項購買的用途。

english: Notify the original author when the correction is ready. Print the correction on the first page of the next issue.
chinese: 更正稿擬備後，請通知原作者。更正啟事須刊於下一期的首頁。

english: Visitors may take photographs during inspection. Staff can explain the layout of the register.
chinese: 職員可解釋登記冊的編排。查閱登記冊時，訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。

english: The demand number can be found next to the billing address. Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence.
chinese: 啟用電子函件服務須使用本期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。繳款通知書編號列於帳單地址旁。

english: Applicants submit a short introduction. Mentors are matched to students by field of interest.
chinese: 校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。申請人須提交簡短自我介紹。

english: The tag helps caretakers identify the flat using the line. Attach the white tag to the new clothesline.
chinese: 請在新晾衣繩掛上白色標籤。管理員可憑標籤辨識使用晾衣繩的單位。

english: Check that the donation slip gives the donor's contact details. Wrap each donated violin bow separately.
chinese: 每支捐贈的小提琴弓均須獨立包裹。請核對捐贈單是否載有捐贈者的聯絡資料。

english: The stand should support an empty folder during the first check. Attach the brace to the rear leg.
chinese: 首次檢查時，譜架應能承托一個空文件夾。請將支撐桿接到後腳。

english: Keep the base of the jig clear of sawdust. Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner still moves after you release the inner guide. The corner should sit flush against both sides of the jig.
chinese: 放開內導件前，如角位會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。角位應貼合定位夾具的兩邊。定位夾具底座不得積有木屑。

english: Wipe mud from the ferrule after use. Stand the pole tip-down to dry the lower shaft.
chinese: 請將手杖杖尖朝下直立，讓下節杖管風乾。使用後請抹去杖頭套的泥污。

english: The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. When checking the repaired scanner, use the first profile in the test guide for the test scan. Delete test scans when the check is complete.
chinese: 完成檢查後須刪除測試掃描檔案。第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第一個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: The briefing recording may be released with the venue operator's consent. A separate leaflet explains the proposed works.
chinese: 工程建議另有單張介紹。取得講者同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。

english: Students may suggest interview questions at the editorial meeting. The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast.
chinese: 學生可於編輯會議提出訪問問題。錄音播出前須取得受訪者同意。

english: Remove loose tape from the collection area. Flatten empty cartons before placing them in the collection cage.
chinese: 空紙箱放入回收籠前，須先壓平。請清走收集區內的散落膠紙。

english: The festival organiser keeps a copy of the closure notice. The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings. Use the original layout plan to check site access.
chinese: 節慶活動主辦機構會保存封路通知副本。改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除，臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。請參照原有平面圖，核對現場出入安排。

english: Attach the white tag to the new clothesline. The old line can be taken to the estate recycling point.
chinese: 舊晾衣繩可送往屋苑回收點。請在新晾衣繩掛上白色標籤。

english: The master worksheet remains unchanged by the export. Export all verified rows, and suppress the notes column for rows with personal data.
chinese: 須匯出所有已核實的資料列，但包含個人資料的資料列不輸出備註欄內容。匯出資料不會改動主工作表。

english: Staff can explain the layout of the register. Visitors may take handwritten notes during inspection.
chinese: 查閱登記冊時，訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。職員可解釋登記冊的編排。

english: Attach the brace to the rear leg. Tighten the thumb screw by hand.
chinese: 請用手擰緊手擰螺絲。請將支撐桿接到前腳。

english: The showcase includes coursework and written comments. When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work from the showcase but retain anonymous remarks unless the remarks identify them. Consent records are held by the year coordinator.
chinese: 學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。同意紀錄由年級統籌主任保管。展覽包含學生習作及書面評語。

english: Export all verified rows, and suppress the notes column for rows with personal data. The export file includes a timestamp in its name. Use the preview to verify each row number.
chinese: 須匯出所有已核實的資料列，但包含個人資料的資料列不輸出備註欄內容。匯出檔案的名稱載有時間戳記。請在預覽中核對每個資料列編號。

english: The host will send the final transcript to the guest. Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments. Please use the show's style sheet for speaker labels.
chinese: 傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前，須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。說話者的姓名標示請參照節目格式指引。主持人會把最終文字稿交給嘉賓。

english: If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold the complainant's home address but a site address that identifies only the mural may be retained. The published list is updated after each review cycle. The contractor can request a map for its work crew.
chinese: 公眾名單會在每輪審核後更新。承辦商可索取地圖供工作隊使用。如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址，但可保留只用作識別壁畫位置的地址。

english: Only the registered resident may collect the loan remote, although either the resident or their nominated driver may return it. The guard will enter the remote's number in the issue log.
chinese: 借用的遙控器只可由登記住戶領取，但登記住戶或其指定司機均可歸還。保安員會在借出紀錄簿填寫遙控器編號。

english: Make a note of the light direction. Set the camera to record RAW files for the lighting exercise.
chinese: 進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存RAW檔案。請記下光線的方向。

english: Set the keyboard to the acoustic piano sound for the practical assessment. Candidates may bring their own sheet music.
chinese: 應考學生可自備樂譜。實習評核須把電子琴設定為原聲鋼琴音色。

english: Record the microchip number shown by the scanner. The examiner should confirm the animal's sex before signing the record.
chinese: 檢查人員應先核實動物性別，再簽署紀錄。請記錄晶片掃描器所顯示的號碼。

english: The published list is updated after each review cycle. If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold the complainant's home address but a site address that identifies only the mural may be retained. The case file contains contact and site details. The contractor can request a map for its work crew.
chinese: 如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址及可識別壁畫位置的地址。個案檔案載有聯絡資料及場地資料。承辦商可索取地圖供工作隊使用。公眾名單會在每輪審核後更新。

english: Set the keyboard to the acoustic piano sound for the practical assessment.
chinese: 實習評核須把電子琴設定為原聲鋼琴音色。

english: The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days. Use the sample book to record the shade number.
chinese: 請將色號記在樣本冊上。紗線樣本可免費借用十四天。

english: Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter. Please keep the space around the counter clear.
chinese: 將飲品單交到櫃檯前，請先填上桌號。請勿阻塞櫃檯一帶。

english: Notify the learning support coordinator if you cannot attend your appointment.
chinese: 如未能出席預約時段，請通知學習支援統籌主任。

english: Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site, but copies may only be released with written permission. General background notes can be downloaded from the consultation page. Staff can help locate drawings by address.
chinese: 訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，但須有書面許可方可取得副本。一般背景資料可從諮詢網頁下載。職員可協助按地址找出圖則。

english: The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group. We will send a separate message when the transcript is ready.
chinese: 文字稿備妥後我們會另行通知。故事分享小組保留錄音只供內部謄寫，並會向小組成員分享經編輯的文字稿。

english: Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets. The cover may be reused from an earlier project.
chinese: 作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。封面可沿用以往專題研習的封面。

english: Wipe the base plate clean between impressions. Insert the artwork with the inked face down.
chinese: 放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝下。每次壓印後請抹乾淨底板。

english: The review panel meets monthly. Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file.
chinese: 附交的插圖須退回寄件人，隨附函件則留在項目檔案。評審小組每月開會。

english: Apply one light coat to the practice sketch. Leave the sketch to dry before putting it in a sleeve.
chinese: 請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。素描乾透後才可放入保護套。

english: Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session. Use the prop's asset number on the inspection form.
chinese: 請在檢查表填寫道具的資產編號。

english: Overshoes are required in the changing corridor.
chinese: 進入更衣走廊須穿上鞋套。

english: Please use the show's style sheet for speaker labels. Spelling corrections can be added in the shared document.
chinese: 說話者的姓名標示請參照節目格式指引。可在共用文件加入拼寫更正。傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前，須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。

english: The petty cash float is capped at HK$400. Keep paper receipts in date order.
chinese: 紙本收據須按日期順序存放。零用現金備用額上限為港幣400元。

english: Insert the artwork with the inked face down. Keep the impression sheet away from direct sunlight while it dries.
chinese: 放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝上。印樣風乾時應避免陽光直射。

english: Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session. Use the prop's asset number on the inspection form.
chinese: 每次保養後，須記錄潤滑劑的批次編號。請在檢查表填寫道具的資產編號。

english: Display the ingredient list next to the nutrition panel. State whether the nutrition figures are for the product as sold or as prepared.
chinese: 須列明營養數值是按出售時還是調配後的產品計算。成分表須列於營養標籤旁。

english: Support the globe by its base while working. Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth.
chinese: 請用乾棉布清潔凸字標籤。清潔時請扶穩地球儀底座。

english: If the storage sleeve feels damp, replace the sleeve before putting the objective away. Return the objective to its labelled drawer. Remove the objective without touching the glass.
chinese: 如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。請將物鏡放回有相應標籤的抽屜。取出物鏡時請勿觸碰鏡片。

english: Record the microchip number shown by the scanner.
chinese: 請記錄晶片掃描器所顯示的號碼。

english: The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings. A supervisor will photograph the site after reinstatement. The festival organiser keeps a copy of the closure notice.
chinese: 還原現場後，督導人員會拍攝現場相片。節慶活動主辦機構會保存封路通知副本。改道指示牌由交通小組拆除，臨時路面標記則由電車營辦商清除。

english: The inventory lists spare fasteners in section A and carrying straps in section B. The receptionist confirms which items have been returned. If a drum requires repair, return the accessories in section B of the inventory, unless the technician has asked you to keep them for a fitting.
chinese: 接待員會確認已交還的物品。清冊A欄列有備用扣件，B欄列有背帶。鼓如須維修，請歸還清冊B欄的配件，但如技術人員要求保留配件以供試裝，則不在此限。

english: Print the correction on the first page of the next issue. Notify the original author when the correction is ready.
chinese: 更正啟事須刊於下一期的末頁。更正稿擬備後，請通知原作者。

english: Staff can help locate drawings by address. Please leave the consultation materials on the reading table after use. Visitors may consult the restricted drawings on site, but copies may only be released with written permission.
chinese: 用畢請把諮詢資料留在閱覽桌上。訪客可在現場查閱受限制的圖則，但須有書面許可方可取得副本。職員可協助按地址找出圖則。

english: Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review. The folder may contain handwritten work.
chinese: 完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾一個學期。資料夾可存放手寫習作。

english: Place damaged volumes on the teacher's desk. Each pupil may check out up to two dictionaries at once.
chinese: 有破損的字典請放在教師桌上。每名學生同時最多可借用兩本字典。

english: A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Record the total number of accepted samples on the batch sheet. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area.
chinese: 請在批次紀錄表填上獲接納的樣本總數。樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按撕裂樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。

english: The festival organiser keeps a copy of the closure notice. Use the original layout plan to check site access. The traffic team removes the diversion signs, and the tram operator removes the temporary road markings.
chinese: 節慶活動主辦機構會保存封路通知副本。請參照原有平面圖，核對現場出入安排。改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除，臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。

english: Volunteers empty collection points at the end of the event. Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice.
chinese: 內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌，方可投放到堆肥收集系統。活動完結時由義工清空收集點。

english: The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. The display technician checks the screen feed before people enter. For a public demonstration, enable the second profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through.
chinese: 觀眾入場前，顯示設備技術員會檢查畫面訊號。第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。

english: Keep the same heat setting while comparing samples. A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area.
chinese: 比較樣本時須維持相同的加熱設定。樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按撕裂樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。

english: The interpreter must be at least 18 years old. The interpreter may ask to review the wording of the declaration.
chinese: 傳譯員須年滿18歲。傳譯員可要求先查閱聲明的措辭。

english: The system sends a confirmation when a token is deactivated. When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate both their lead-guide token and any observer token immediately. The register records the role attached to each token. Existing route bookings remain available to the replacement guide.
