chinese: 導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊通行憑證；觀察員通行憑證則保留至該次導賞完結。登記冊列明每個通行憑證所對應的身分。接任導賞員仍可使用已預約的路線時段。通行憑證停用後，系統會發出確認通知。

english: Use the shared folder to file the rehearsal notes. Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script.
chinese: 舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本後，才可修改場務提示表。彩排紀錄須存入共用資料夾。

english: The suspension decision is served by registered post.
chinese: 暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。

english: Place unused ticket books in a separate tray. Seal the stall's cash pouch before handing it over.
chinese: 攤位交收現金袋前，須先將袋口封妥。未使用的票簿請另放一盤。

english: The community room administrator arranges collection from the donor. Tell us if the piano has a separate bench.
chinese: 如鋼琴附有獨立琴凳，請告知我們。捐贈者須安排把鋼琴送至社區活動室。

english: A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand. The team will give the caretaker an updated visit list. Residents may appoint someone to open the door for them.
chinese: 如有單位未能接受檢查，只須為該單位另作安排，其他單位的預約維持原定時間。小組會向管理員提供更新後的到訪名單。住戶可委託他人代為開門。

english: Please keep phone conversations outside the quiet floor. A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present.
chinese: 陪同者只可在所陪同的讀者在場時，使用安靜樓層的預留座位。請離開安靜樓層後才通電話。

english: The system sends a confirmation when a token is deactivated. When a guide leaves the scheme, deactivate their lead-guide token immediately and retain any observer token until the end of the current tour. The register records the role attached to each token.
chinese: 通行憑證停用後，系統會發出確認通知。導賞員退出計劃時，須立即停用其領隊通行憑證；觀察員通行憑證則保留至該次導賞完結。登記冊列明每個通行憑證所對應的身分。

english: The booth keeps a printed working copy. Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script. Write the scene number beside each change.
chinese: 須在舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本前修改場務提示表。請在各項變更旁註明場次。控制室備有供工作使用的紙本。

english: Return serviceable road studs to stores only after the inspection team signs the recovery sheet. Scrap metal goes into a separate container.
chinese: 廢金屬須放入另一容器。狀況良好的路面反光標只能在檢查小組簽署回收紀錄後送回物料倉。

english: Keep a copy with the tenancy documents. The clearance certificate remains valid for six months after issue.
chinese: 合格證明書自簽發日起六個月內有效。請把副本與租賃文件一併保存。

english: The screening includes audio description. Ushers can help you find the accessible seating area.
chinese: 場務人員可指引你前往無障礙座位區。放映場次不設口述影像服務。

english: Set the camera to record RAW files for the lighting exercise. Make a note of the light direction.
chinese: 請記下光線的方向。進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存JPEG檔案。

english: The interviewee must approve the recording before broadcast. Keep the unedited track in the production folder.
chinese: 請在製作資料夾保留未經剪輯的音軌。錄音播出前須取得受訪者同意。

english: The hall calendar shows provisional requests in grey. Contact the booking volunteer after the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot. You will receive your own booking reference if the transfer goes through.
chinese: 原租用者確認釋出時段後，方可聯絡處理預約的義工。轉讓成功後，你會獲發自己的預約編號。會堂日曆以灰色標示暫定申請。

english: An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available. The seminar is recorded for students who miss the live session.
chinese: 退出發布的選擇只適用於影片，文字記錄仍可供查閱。研討會設錄影，方便未能出席的學生。

english: Set the right margin to 8 mm before printing the labels. A preview appears on the printer screen.
chinese: 列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為8毫米。預覽會顯示在打印機的屏幕上。

english: Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script. Write the scene number beside each change.
chinese: 舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本後，才可修改場務提示表。請在各項變更旁註明場次。

english: Start the thread by hand before tightening it with the tool. Use the 12 mm screw to join the binder covers.
chinese: 請用12毫米螺絲接合文件夾的封面及封底。先用手旋入螺絲，再用工具擰緊。

english: Use the spelling you want printed. Students may use their preferred first name in the yearbook.
chinese: 學生可在畢業紀念冊使用自己選用的名字。請填寫你希望印在紀念冊上的拼法。

english: The screening does not include audio description. The doors will open before the introduction.
chinese: 放映場次設有口述影像服務。入場門會在開場介紹前開放。

english: The donor arranges delivery to the community room. The piano's dimensions should be included on the inventory.
chinese: 清冊應列明鋼琴的尺寸。捐贈者須安排把鋼琴送至社區活動室。

english: The attendance system keeps a separate list for each session. Slides will be shared separately by the presenter. An opt-out covers publication of both the video and the written transcript.
chinese: 考勤系統會分別保存每節活動的出席名單。講者會另行分享投影片。退出發布的選擇只適用於影片，文字記錄仍可供查閱。

english: Set the right margin to 8 mm before printing the labels.
chinese: 列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為8毫米。

english: Print the correction on the first page of the next issue.
chinese: 更正啟事須刊於下一期的首頁。

english: Check the pedal's action in the test document. Assign the left pedal to page back.
chinese: 請將左踏板設定為翻至上一頁。請在測試文件中檢查踏板功能。

english: The payment provider receives the reference number by secure message. The canteen may record the case without immediately changing the balance. If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds. The account shows the sequence of transfers.
chinese: 參考編號會以保安訊息發給付款服務商。飯堂可先登記事件，毋須即時調整結餘。如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷第二次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理首次轉移。帳戶會顯示各次轉移的先後次序。

english: The referee flags an unauthorised substitute, and the tournament secretary corrects the team sheet. Captains may inspect the updated register after the match.
chinese: 賽後隊長可查閱已更新的紀錄。未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。

english: Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink. The inspection sheet records the date of installation.
chinese: 檢查表載有安裝日期。濕度指示卡有兩格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。

english: Return the temporary lunch card in person. Remove the plastic holder before handing back the card.
chinese: 交還午膳卡前，請取下膠套。臨時午膳卡須親身交還。

english: The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition, except during a live demonstration. Visitors may wait in the foyer while a demonstration is running. Each group collects its badges together at the start of the tour.
chinese: 臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地，但現場示範期間除外。現場示範期間，訪客可在大堂等候。各組別須在導賞開始時一同領取臨時證。

english: Each registered organisation has one vote on the mural shortlist. The panel will publish a summary of the feedback received.
chinese: 每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投兩票。評審小組會公布收到的意見摘要。

english: The workshop ticket includes one drink. Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter.
chinese: 將飲品單交到櫃檯前，請先填上桌號。工作坊門票包括一杯飲品。

english: Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place. Keep removed clips in the storage pouch. Check that the cabinet is level before filling it.
chinese: 安裝後須拆除運輸固定夾，但固定可拆式層板的夾具除外。已拆除的夾具須放入收納袋。放入物品前須確認展示櫃放置平穩。

english: The insert fits around the corners of the product. Remove the adhesive strip before folding the insert.
chinese: 內襯套在產品的各個角位。摺疊內襯前，請先移除黏貼帶。

english: Print the correction on the first page of the next issue. The archive keeps the original issue available.
chinese: 資料庫仍可供查閱原有期刊。更正啟事須刊於下一期的首頁。

english: Contact the booking volunteer after the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot. The hall calendar shows provisional requests in grey.
chinese: 原租用者確認釋出時段後，方可聯絡處理預約的義工。會堂日曆以灰色標示暫定申請。

english: Insert the artwork with the inked face down. Wipe the base plate clean between impressions.
chinese: 每次壓印後請抹乾淨底板。放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝下。

english: Each registered organisation has one vote on the mural shortlist.
chinese: 每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投一票。

english: The contractor can request a map for its work crew. The published list is updated after each review cycle. If a maintenance complaint is published, withhold the complainant's home address but a site address that identifies only the mural may be retained. The case file contains contact and site details.
chinese: 承辦商可索取地圖供工作隊使用。公眾名單會在每輪審核後更新。如公開壁畫保養投訴，須隱去投訴人的住址及可識別壁畫位置的地址。個案檔案載有聯絡資料及場地資料。

english: Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts. A coach will direct players to their assigned court.
chinese: 教練會指示球員前往所屬球場。選拔試場地可穿着黑底鞋。

english: Test the spray pattern on scrap paper. Apply one light coat to the practice sketch.
chinese: 請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。請先在廢紙上試噴，檢查噴霧形狀。

english: Each group collects its badges together at the start of the tour. The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition only during a live demonstration. Visitors may wait in the foyer while a demonstration is running.
chinese: 臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地，但現場示範期間除外。現場示範期間，訪客可在大堂等候。各組別須在導賞開始時一同領取臨時證。

english: Equipment requests are recorded on a separate form. Contact the booking volunteer before the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot. The hall calendar shows provisional requests in grey.
chinese: 原租用者確認釋出時段後，方可聯絡處理預約的義工。會堂日曆以灰色標示暫定申請。器材申請另用表格記錄。

english: Each pupil may check out up to two dictionaries at once. Place damaged volumes on the teacher's desk.
chinese: 每名學生同時最多可借用兩本字典。有破損的字典請放在教師桌上。

english: Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth. Support the globe by its base while working.
chinese: 清潔時請扶穩地球儀底座。請用濕棉布清潔凸字標籤。

english: The donor arranges delivery to the community room. The piano will be tuned after it arrives.
chinese: 捐贈者須安排把鋼琴送至社區活動室。鋼琴送抵後會安排調音。

english: Use the sterile glass bottle supplied with the sampling kit. Note any visible surface film in the field log.
chinese: 如水面有可見薄膜，請在實地紀錄簿註明。請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。

english: Mentors are matched to students by year group. Applicants submit a short introduction.
chinese: 申請人須提交簡短自我介紹。校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。

english: The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition, except during a live demonstration. Visitors may wait in the foyer while a demonstration is running.
chinese: 臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地，但現場示範期間除外。現場示範期間，訪客可在大堂等候。

english: Officers retain a copy in the permit file. The suspension decision is served by registered post.
chinese: 暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。人員會在許可證檔案內保留副本。

english: Please use the show's style sheet for speaker labels. Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments. Spelling corrections can be added in the shared document.
chinese: 說話者的姓名標示請參照節目格式指引。傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前，須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。可在共用文件加入拼寫更正。

english: The team will give the caretaker an updated visit list. A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand. Leave enough space for the inspector to reach the shutoff valve.
chinese: 如有單位未能接受檢查，只須為該單位另作安排，其他單位的預約維持原定時間。請預留足夠空間，方便檢查人員接觸截流閥。小組會向管理員提供更新後的到訪名單。

english: The interpreter must be at least 18 years old. Tell the registry which language will be used for interpretation.
chinese: 請向登記處說明傳譯所用的語言。傳譯員須年滿18歲。

english: There is a separate sound check at the performance venue. Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime. The school check uses the performance seating plan.
chinese: 外來樂手如已完成場地試音，可豁免學校試音，但其間曾更換樂器者除外。學校試音按演出座位表安排。演出場地另設試音環節。

english: Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence. The demand number can be found next to the billing address.
chinese: 繳款通知書編號列於帳單地址旁。啟用電子函件服務須使用本期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。

english: A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area. Keep the same heat setting while comparing samples. Record the total number of accepted samples on the batch sheet.
chinese: 樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按撕裂樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。比較樣本時須維持相同的加熱設定。請在批次紀錄表填上獲接納的樣本總數。

english: A map identifies the reserved desks. A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present. Please keep phone conversations outside the quiet floor.
chinese: 陪同者只可在所陪同的讀者在場時，使用安靜樓層的預留座位。請離開安靜樓層後才通電話。平面圖上標有預留書桌的位置。

english: A volunteer keeps a list of the contributions received. We will send a separate message when the transcript is ready. The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group.
chinese: 義工會備存已收到的分享內容清單。文字稿備妥後我們會另行通知。故事分享小組會向小組成員分享錄音及經編輯的文字稿。

english: Provide a description of the blockage on the request form. There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection.
chinese: 首次申請渠務檢查毋須繳費。請在申請表說明淤塞情況。

english: Please copy the current pin label into your message. We accept a pin change only if both the venue manager and the original contributor confirm it. The update form asks for a brief description of the proposed change.
chinese: 地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認，便可更改。更新表要求簡述擬作的改動。請在訊息內抄錄現有地圖標記的標籤。

english: The festival organiser keeps a copy of the closure notice. The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings.
chinese: 改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除，臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。節慶活動主辦機構會保存封路通知副本。

english: Visitors may take handwritten notes during inspection. Show the inspection booking confirmation on arrival.
chinese: 抵達後請出示查閱預約確認。查閱登記冊時，訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。

english: If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake. The register records the actual start of each candidate's session. Any existing scripts must be handed to the exams officer.
chinese: 如監考員缺席，只有未能開始應考的學生可申請重考。登記冊會記錄每名考生的實際開考時間。已派出的答題卷須交予考務主任。

english: Club members can flag duplicate images for the editor. Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed. The caption may identify the species.
chinese: 學會會員可標記重複相片，供編輯處理。只有在刪除坐標後，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。相片說明可註明物種。

english: Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets.
chinese: 作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。

english: The screening includes audio description.
chinese: 放映場次設有口述影像服務。

english: The student supplies their own application number. A student may preview the factual information and the teacher's comments on a reference form. Requests are handled through the guidance office.
chinese: 學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料，但教師評語仍屬保密。申請由升學輔導辦事處處理。學生須自行提供申請編號。

english: Use headphones when reviewing recordings in class. Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio.
chinese: 每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。在課堂上重聽錄音時，請戴上耳機。

english: The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings. A supervisor will photograph the site after reinstatement. Use the original layout plan to check site access.
chinese: 改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除，臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。還原現場後，督導人員會拍攝現場相片。請參照原有平面圖，核對現場出入安排。

english: Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim. State which project the expenditure relates to.
chinese: 請說明開支所屬的項目。申請發還款項時須提交分項發票。

english: The map editor checks for duplicate locations. We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it.
chinese: 地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認，便可更改。地圖編輯人員會檢查是否有重複地點。

english: The exhibition covers several periods of local history. If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first. Pupils may keep the spare sheets after the outing.
chinese: 學生借出影印本前，須先清除背面的個人筆記。活動結束後學生可保留剩餘的畫紙。展覽涵蓋本地歷史的不同時期。

english: Use the sample book to record the shade number. The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days.
chinese: 紗線樣本可免費借用十天。請將色號記在樣本冊上。

english: We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it. The update form asks for a brief description of the proposed change.
chinese: 地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認，便可更改。更新表要求簡述擬作的改動。

english: Use the sterile glass bottle supplied with the sampling kit.
chinese: 請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。

english: Members may add removable notes to the loan copy. The discussion guide is attached to this email.
chinese: 討論指引見本電郵附件。會員可直接在借閱本上書寫。

english: Keep the event organiser's telephone number with you. The café meeting point is the same for both routes. The covered route replaces the waterside route if rain is forecast, except for participants already assigned a shuttle.
chinese: 兩條路線的集合地點均為同一間咖啡店。如預報有雨，行程會由水邊路線改用有蓋路線，已獲安排接駁車的參加者除外。請隨身備存活動主辦人的電話號碼。

english: The decision letter states the reasons for suspension. The suspension decision is served by registered post.
chinese: 暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。決定書列明暫停許可證的理由。

english: Please avoid hanging wet items over the footpath. Attach the white tag to the new clothesline.
chinese: 請勿把濕衣物晾掛在行人徑上方。請在新晾衣繩掛上白色標籤。

english: Notify the attendance secretary if you cannot attend your appointment. The appointment reminder contains a map of the building.
chinese: 如未能出席預約時段，請通知學習支援統籌主任。預約提示附有大樓位置圖。

english: Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen. The response team may request additional photographs.
chinese: 應變小組可要求提供更多相片。請記錄接獲油膜報告的時間。

english: Push the latch inward to lower the trolley handle. Leave the platform empty while adjusting the handle.
chinese: 調整手柄時，平台上不得放置物件。向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。

english: If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake. The register records the actual start of each candidate's session.
chinese: 如監考員缺席，只有未能開始應考的學生可申請重考。登記冊會記錄每名考生的實際開考時間。

english: The digital catalogue uses the same showcase rules. When a pupil withdraws consent to share coursework, remove their work and all anonymous remarks from the showcase. The showcase includes coursework and written comments. Consent records are held by the year coordinator.
chinese: 學生撤回分享習作的同意後，須將其習作從展覽撤下；匿名評語可保留，但足以識別該學生的評語除外。展覽包含學生習作及書面評語。同意紀錄由年級統籌主任保管。電子圖錄適用相同的展示規則。

english: Set the camera to record RAW files for the lighting exercise. Use the same tripod for each exposure.
chinese: 每次曝光須使用同一個三腳架。進行燈光練習時，請將相機設定為儲存RAW檔案。

english: The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings. Use the original layout plan to check site access.
chinese: 請參照原有平面圖，核對現場出入安排。改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除，臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。

english: Line the collection box with a paper bag. Put damp papers in the general waste bin.
chinese: 濕報紙請投放到一般垃圾桶。請在收集箱內鋪上膠袋。

english: Seal the stall's cash pouch before handing it over. Place unused ticket books in a separate tray.
chinese: 未使用的票簿請另放一盤。攤位交收現金袋前，須先將袋口封妥。

english: Record the total number of accepted samples on the batch sheet. A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder. Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area. Keep the same heat setting while comparing samples.
chinese: 請在批次紀錄表填上獲接納的樣本總數。樣本如有撕裂，須記錄並重新試印；完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。起皺樣本亦按完好樣本的方式處理，但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。比較樣本時須維持相同的加熱設定。

english: Any existing scripts must be handed to the exams officer. If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake. The register records the actual start of each candidate's session.
chinese: 如監考員缺席，只有已開始應考的學生可申請重考。登記冊會記錄每名考生的實際開考時間。已派出的答題卷須交予考務主任。

english: Each cassette should be logged by its title. In the log key, a steady light means rewind is complete and a flashing light means rewind is still underway. Start the next cassette once the indicator shows the first code in the log key.
chinese: 每盒錄音帶須按其標題登記。紀錄簿圖例列明，長亮表示回帶完成，閃動表示仍在回帶。指示燈出現紀錄簿圖例的第一個代碼後，方可處理下一盒錄音帶。

english: Food scraps are sorted at the venue. Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice. Clean liners are stocked at the reception desk.
chinese: 內袋只要有任何可堆肥標誌，便可投放到堆肥收集系統。接待處備有清潔的內袋。廚餘須在會場分類。

english: Set the right margin to 8 mm before printing the labels. Return unused labels to the storage bag.
chinese: 請將未使用的標籤放回儲存袋。列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為8毫米。

english: The grant report may include photos of the equipment in use. Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the recipient organisation.
chinese: 資助報告可附上使用器材的相片。以資助金購買的器材歸受資助機構所有。

english: Contact the booking volunteer after the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot. The hall calendar shows provisional requests in grey. Equipment requests are recorded on a separate form.
chinese: 原租用者確認釋出時段後，方可聯絡處理預約的義工。會堂日曆以灰色標示暫定申請。器材申請另用表格記錄。

english: A coach will direct players to their assigned court. Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts.
chinese: 選拔試場地禁止穿着黑底鞋。教練會指示球員前往所屬球場。

english: The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses. Each house can check its full breakdown with the quiz convenor.
chinese: 各社隊可向問答比賽召集人查閱本隊的詳細得分。計分板只顯示排名首五名的社隊分數。

english: Push the latch inward to lower the trolley handle. The handle locks into place at its lowest setting.
chinese: 手柄調至最低位置時會鎖定。向外拉動鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。

english: We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it. The update form asks for a brief description of the proposed change. The map editor checks for duplicate locations.
chinese: 更新表要求簡述擬作的改動。地圖編輯人員會檢查是否有重複地點。地圖標記須獲場地經理及原提供資料者雙方確認，方可更改。

english: Flatten empty cartons before placing them in the collection cage. Staff clear the cage before the morning delivery.
chinese: 空紙箱放入回收籠前，須先壓平。職員會在早上送貨前清空回收籠。

english: Use the original layout plan to check site access. The festival organiser keeps a copy of the closure notice. The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings.
chinese: 節慶活動主辦機構會保存封路通知副本。改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除，臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。請參照原有平面圖，核對現場出入安排。

english: Please keep phone conversations outside the quiet floor. A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present. Other seats can be used without a booking.
chinese: 請離開安靜樓層後才通電話。陪同者只可在所陪同的讀者在場時，使用安靜樓層的預留座位。其他座位毋須預約。

english: Each member may bring one guest on the walk. Clothing suitable for the weather is recommended.
chinese: 建議穿着適合當日天氣的衣物。每名會員可攜同兩名賓客參加步行導賞。

english: The display technician checks the screen feed before people enter. The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. For a public demonstration, enable the second profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through.
chinese: 觀眾入場前，顯示設備技術員會檢查畫面訊號。第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。

english: Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner still moves after you release the inner guide. The corner should sit flush against both sides of the jig. Keep the base of the jig clear of sawdust.
chinese: 放開內導件後，如角位仍會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。角位應貼合定位夾具的兩邊。定位夾具底座不得積有木屑。

english: A student may preview the factual information on a reference form, but the teacher's comments remain confidential. Requests are handled through the guidance office. The student supplies their own application number.
chinese: 學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料，但教師評語仍屬保密。申請由升學輔導辦事處處理。學生須自行提供申請編號。

english: Visitors may wait in the foyer while a demonstration is running. The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition, except during a live demonstration. Please keep the badge visible throughout the tour.
chinese: 臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地，但現場示範期間除外。導賞期間請全程在顯眼處佩戴臨時證。現場示範期間，訪客可在大堂等候。

english: The donor arranges delivery to the community room. Tell us if the piano has a separate bench.
chinese: 如鋼琴附有獨立琴凳，請告知我們。捐贈者須安排把鋼琴送至社區活動室。

english: Place unused ticket books in a separate tray.
chinese: 未使用的票簿請另放一盤。攤位交收現金袋前，須先將袋口封妥。

english: The call record distinguishes colour complaints from pressure complaints. For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water before supply has resumed. Operators can check the restoration time in the repair log.
chinese: 水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。接線人員可在維修紀錄查閱恢復供水時間。來電紀錄會區分水色和水壓投訴。

english: The suspension decision is served by ordinary post. The decision letter states the reasons for suspension.
chinese: 決定書列明暫停許可證的理由。暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。

english: Check that the cabinet is level before filling it. Remove the transport clips after installation, except for those holding a removable shelf in place. Keep removed clips in the storage pouch.
chinese: 安裝後只須拆除固定可拆式層板的運輸固定夾。已拆除的夾具須放入收納袋。放入物品前須確認展示櫃放置平穩。

english: Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath above it. Record any vegetation obscuring the wall surface.
chinese: 請記錄遮擋牆面的植物。請從擋土牆上方的行人徑拍攝牆身。

english: The society may waive the second subscription for siblings in the same household, provided that both renew together. A single receipt lists the names of all members covered by the payment. The secretary will confirm any change of address before updating the register.
chinese: 收據會列出同一筆款項所涵蓋的全體會員姓名。秘書會先確認地址變更，再更新會員名冊。即使分開續會，同住的兄弟姊妹亦可獲社團豁免第二人的會費。

english: Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session. Return the handle to its parked position after servicing.
chinese: 保養後請將搖柄放回停放位置。每次保養後，須記錄潤滑劑的批次編號。

english: The certificate states the address of the unit. The clearance certificate remains valid for six months after issue.
chinese: 合格證明書自簽發日起六個月內有效。證明書列明單位地址。

english: Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath below it. Include the survey pole in the frame.
chinese: 相片須攝入測量桿。請從擋土牆上方的行人徑拍攝牆身。

english: The scoreboard is updated on Fridays. Only completed matches count towards ladder points.
chinese: 計分板逢星期五更新。只有打完的比賽才計入排名賽積分。

english: A student may preview the factual information on a reference form, but the teacher's comments remain confidential. The student supplies their own application number.
chinese: 學生須自行提供申請編號。學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料，但教師評語仍屬保密。

english: Keep the wrist strap away from the drying surface. Stand the pole tip-down to dry the lower shaft.
chinese: 請將手杖杖尖朝下直立，讓下節杖管風乾。請避免腕帶接觸風乾用的表面。

english: The property account number remains the same. Use the new meter's opening reading as the billing baseline.
chinese: 處所的帳戶號碼維持不變。請以新水錶的起始讀數作為計費基準。

english: Pay the jar deposit by bank transfer. One deposit is recorded for each jar.
chinese: 每個玻璃瓶的按金會分開記錄。玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。

english: A supervisor will photograph the site after reinstatement. The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings. The festival organiser keeps a copy of the closure notice.
chinese: 改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除，臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。節慶活動主辦機構會保存封路通知副本。還原現場後，督導人員會拍攝現場相片。

english: Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence.
chinese: 啟用電子函件服務須使用本期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。

english: Record the microchip number supplied by the animal's owner. The examiner should confirm the animal's sex before signing the record.
chinese: 檢查人員應先核實動物性別，再簽署紀錄。請記錄晶片掃描器所顯示的號碼。

english: The interpreter should arrive with the parties. The interpreter must be at least 18 years old.
chinese: 傳譯員須年滿18歲。傳譯員應與各方一同到場。

english: The response team may request additional photographs. Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen.
chinese: 請記錄首次發現油膜的時間。應變小組可要求提供更多相片。

english: Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio. Begin the recording with the title of the passage.
chinese: 每段發音練習錄音均須上載至班級動態。開始錄音時，請先讀出篇章標題。

english: The briefing recording may be released with the speaker's consent. Members of the public may submit written follow-up questions.
chinese: 取得場地營辦商同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。市民可其後以書面提交跟進問題。

english: Print the correction on the first page of the next issue. Quote the title of the affected article.
chinese: 請引述有關文章的標題。更正啟事須刊於下一期的末頁。

english: Ushers can help you find the accessible seating area. The screening includes audio description.
chinese: 放映場次設有口述影像服務。場務人員可指引你前往無障礙座位區。

english: Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim. Staff may contact applicants to clarify unusual purchases.
chinese: 申請發還款項時須提交報價單。職員可聯絡申請人查問不尋常的購買項目。

english: Clothing suitable for the weather is recommended. Each member may bring one guest on the walk.
chinese: 每名會員可攜同一名賓客參加步行導賞。建議穿着適合當日天氣的衣物。

english: Insert the artwork with the inked face down. Hold the frame steady until the image transfers.
chinese: 請固定框架，直至圖案轉印完成。放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝上。

english: Work with the sketch laid flat. Apply one light coat to the practice sketch.
chinese: 請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。請將素描平放後才處理。

english: Spelling corrections can be added in the shared document. Please use the show's style sheet for speaker labels. Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments.
chinese: 說話者的姓名標示請參照節目格式指引。傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前，須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。可在共用文件加入拼寫更正。

english: Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review. The folder may contain handwritten work.
chinese: 完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾兩個學期。資料夾可存放手寫習作。

english: Pay the jar deposit by bank transfer. The jar sizes are listed on the order form.
chinese: 訂購表列有各款玻璃瓶的容量。玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。

english: Use the sterile glass bottle supplied with the sampling kit. Record the water temperature at the sampling point.
chinese: 請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。請記錄採樣點的水溫。

english: Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice. Food scraps are sorted at the venue.
chinese: 廚餘須在會場分類。內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌，方可投放到堆肥收集系統。

english: Members can try the samples on the practice loom. The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days.
chinese: 會員可在練習用織機試用樣本。紗線樣本可免費借用十天。

english: Each submission is assigned a project reference. Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file. The review panel meets monthly.
chinese: 附交的插圖須退回寄件人，隨附函件則留在項目檔案。評審小組每月開會。每份呈交的文件均獲編配項目參考編號。

english: Any existing scripts must be handed to the exams officer. A written confirmation will be issued for each approved retake. If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake.
chinese: 重考申請獲批後，考生會收到書面確認。如監考員缺席，只有未能開始應考的學生可申請重考。已派出的答題卷須交予考務主任。

english: The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. For a public demonstration, enable the second profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through. The display technician checks the screen feed before people enter.
chinese: 觀眾入場前，顯示設備技術員會檢查畫面訊號。第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。

english: The caption may identify the species. Club members can flag duplicate images for the editor. Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed.
chinese: 學會會員可標記重複相片，供編輯處理。只有在刪除坐標後，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。相片說明可註明物種。

english: The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses. Question scores are entered after each round.
chinese: 計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。每輪結束後會輸入該輪題目的得分。

english: Begin the recording with the title of the passage. Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio.
chinese: 開始錄音時，請先讀出篇章標題。每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。

english: The officer receiving the property signs the inventory. The inventory carries the case number.
chinese: 物品清單載有個案編號。物品清單由接收遺物的人員簽署。

english: Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth.
chinese: 請用乾棉布清潔凸字標籤。

english: Mentors are matched to students by field of interest. Applicants submit a short introduction.
chinese: 申請人須提交簡短自我介紹。校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。

english: The referee flags an unauthorised substitute, and the tournament secretary corrects the team sheet. Keep the original team sheet with the match report.
chinese: 未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報，隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。請把原有隊伍名單與比賽報告一併保存。

english: An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available. The seminar is recorded for students who miss the live session. Slides will be shared separately by the presenter.
chinese: 退出發布的選擇只適用於影片，文字記錄仍可供查閱。研討會設錄影，方便未能出席的學生。講者會另行分享投影片。

english: The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days. Return unused strands in the original sleeve.
chinese: 未用完的紗線須放回原有封套交還。紗線樣本可免費借用十天。

english: The call record distinguishes colour complaints from pressure complaints. For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks. Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water after supply has resumed. Urgent safety calls continue to go straight to the response team.
chinese: 水壓中斷期間接獲的來電，須暫緩例行回電。住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色，則須優先處理。緊急安全求助仍直接轉介應變小組。來電紀錄會區分水色和水壓投訴。

english: Keep cleaning materials in the maintenance cupboard. Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session.
chinese: 每次保養後，須記錄潤滑劑的批次編號。清潔物料請存放於保養用品櫃。

english: Liners can enter the compost collection stream if they carry any compostability mark. Clean liners are stocked at the reception desk. Volunteers empty collection points at the end of the event.
chinese: 接待處備有清潔的內袋。活動完結時由義工清空收集點。內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌，方可投放到堆肥收集系統。

english: The interpreter may ask to review the wording of the declaration. The interpreter must be at least 18 years old.
chinese: 傳譯員可要求先查閱聲明的措辭。傳譯員須年滿18歲。

english: There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection. The inspection team will phone the tenant before visiting.
chinese: 檢查人員上門前會致電租戶。首次申請渠務檢查毋須繳費。

english: The folder may contain handwritten work. Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review.
chinese: 資料夾可存放手寫習作。完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾一個學期。

english: Notify the learning support coordinator if you cannot attend your appointment. Bring any worksheets you wish to discuss.
chinese: 如有希望討論的工作紙，請一併帶來。如未能出席預約時段，請通知學習支援統籌主任。

english: Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets. Label the dividers along the outside edge.
chinese: 請在分隔頁的外側邊緣加上標籤。作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。

english: The account shows the sequence of transfers. The payment provider receives the reference number by secure message. If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds.
chinese: 參考編號會以保安訊息發給付款服務商。如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷首次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理第二次轉移。帳戶會顯示各次轉移的先後次序。

english: Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink. Wash and dry your hands before handling a new card.
chinese: 濕度指示卡有三格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。觸碰新指示卡前，請洗手並把雙手抹乾。

english: The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses.
chinese: 計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。

english: The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. When checking the repaired scanner, use the second profile in the test guide for the test scan. Delete test scans when the check is complete.
chinese: 完成檢查後須刪除測試掃描檔案。第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第一個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: Describe the appearance of the sheen in the incident log. Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen.
chinese: 請記錄首次發現油膜的時間。請在事故紀錄內描述油膜的外觀。

english: Both readings appear on the replacement record. Use the new meter's opening reading as the billing baseline.
chinese: 請以新水錶的起始讀數作為計費基準。更換紀錄載有兩個讀數。

english: Insert the artwork with the inked face down.
chinese: 放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝下。

english: The seminar is recorded for students who miss the live session. An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available. The attendance system keeps a separate list for each session.
chinese: 退出發布的選擇只適用於影片，文字記錄仍可供查閱。考勤系統會分別保存每節活動的出席名單。研討會設錄影，方便未能出席的學生。

english: Stand the pole tip-down to dry the lower shaft. Store the pole indoors once dry.
chinese: 請將手杖杖尖朝上直立，讓下節杖管風乾。風乾後請在室內存放手杖。

english: Write the accession number on the borrowing slip. Each pupil may check out up to two dictionaries at once.
chinese: 每名學生同時最多可借用兩本字典。請在借用單填寫館藏編號。

english: Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review. Keep teacher comments with the corresponding drafts.
chinese: 教師的評語應與相應的草稿一併保存。完成最後一次檢視後，請保留寫作資料夾兩個學期。

english: Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed. Keep any redeemed voucher number for your records. The desk volunteer checks the voucher record before confirming eligibility.
chinese: 藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用藍色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。請自行保存已兌換的券號。櫃檯義工會先查閱券的紀錄，再確認資格。

english: Leave empty cartons intact when placing them in the collection cage. Remove loose tape from the collection area.
chinese: 請清走收集區內的散落膠紙。空紙箱放入回收籠前，須先壓平。

english: Do not apply glue while checking the fit. Tighten the outer clamp only if the corner still moves after you release the inner guide.
chinese: 放開內導件後，如角位仍會移動，才可擰緊外側夾具。檢查接合位置時請勿塗膠。

english: Each registered organisation has two votes on the mural shortlist. Samples of the colour palette are available at the exhibition.
chinese: 展覽現場備有色板樣本。每個已登記的機構可就入圍壁畫方案投一票。

english: If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first. Teachers distribute the sketching sheets on the bus.
chinese: 老師會在旅遊車上派發速寫紙。學生借出影印本前，須先清除背面的個人筆記。

english: Mentors are matched to students by field of interest.
chinese: 校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。

english: The interpreter must be at least 18 years old.
chinese: 傳譯員須年滿18歲。

english: The student supplies their own application number. The receiving institution keeps its own copy of the form. A student may preview the factual information on a reference form, but the teacher's comments remain confidential.
chinese: 接收院校會自行存檔。學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料，但教師評語仍屬保密。學生須自行提供申請編號。

english: The free yarn sample loan lasts fourteen days. Members can try the samples on the practice loom.
chinese: 紗線樣本可免費借用十天。會員可在練習用織機試用樣本。

english: Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed. Original files remain in the restricted research folder. The caption may identify the species.
chinese: 只有在刪除坐標後，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。原始檔案會保留在限制存取的研究資料夾。相片說明可註明物種。

english: The interpreter must be at least 18 years old. The interpreter may ask to review the wording of the declaration.
chinese: 傳譯員須年滿21歲。傳譯員可要求先查閱聲明的措辭。

english: Insert the artwork with the inked face down. Keep the impression sheet away from direct sunlight while it dries.
chinese: 放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝下。印樣風乾時應避免陽光直射。

english: Use the original layout plan to check site access. The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings. A supervisor will photograph the site after reinstatement.
chinese: 改道指示牌由交通小組拆除，臨時路面標記則由電車營辦商清除。還原現場後，督導人員會拍攝現場相片。請參照原有平面圖，核對現場出入安排。

english: Return the handle to its parked position after servicing.
chinese: 保養後請將搖柄放回停放位置。每次保養後，須記錄潤滑劑的批次編號。

english: Apply one light coat to the practice sketch. Work with the sketch laid flat.
chinese: 請將素描平放後才處理。請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。

english: Keep the impression sheet away from direct sunlight while it dries. Insert the artwork with the inked face down.
chinese: 印樣風乾時應避免陽光直射。放入圖樣時，有油墨的一面須朝下。

english: Equipment requests are recorded on a separate form. You will receive your own booking reference if the transfer goes through. Contact the booking volunteer after the previous hirer confirms the release of the slot.
chinese: 轉讓成功後，你會獲發自己的預約編號。原租用者確認釋出時段後，方可聯絡處理預約的義工。器材申請另用表格記錄。

english: The display technician checks the screen feed before people enter. The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names. For a public demonstration, enable the first profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through. The image format is the same under both profiles.
chinese: 觀眾入場前，顯示設備技術員會檢查畫面訊號。第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註，第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔；即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕，亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。兩個設定檔所用的影像格式相同。

english: The receiving institution keeps its own copy of the form. A student may preview the factual information on a reference form, but the teacher's comments remain confidential. The student supplies their own application number.
chinese: 接收院校會自行存檔。學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料，但教師評語仍屬保密。學生須自行提供申請編號。

english: Set the right margin to 8 mm before printing the labels. Use a ruler to check the first printed label.
chinese: 請用間尺核對第一張已列印的標籤。列印標籤前，請將右邊界設定為6毫米。

english: Leave enough space for the inspector to reach the shutoff valve. Residents may appoint someone to open the door for them. A missed inspection is rescheduled along with the appointments for all other flats.
chinese: 請預留足夠空間，方便檢查人員接觸截流閥。住戶可委託他人代為開門。如有單位未能接受檢查，只須為該單位另作安排，其他單位的預約維持原定時間。

english: Each pupil may check out up to two dictionaries at once.
chinese: 每名學生同時最多可借用兩本字典。

english: The shelter itself remains available. The grounds team will inspect seed growth each week. The lawn can reopen after seeding, except in the marked section beside the shelter.
chinese: 園務小組會每周檢查種子生長情況。草地完成播種後可重開，但涼亭旁有標記的部分除外。涼亭照常開放。

english: Notify the learning support coordinator if you cannot attend your appointment. Bring any worksheets you wish to discuss.
chinese: 如有希望討論的工作紙，請一併帶來。如未能出席預約時段，請通知考勤秘書。

english: Overshoes are required in the changing corridor. Shoes can be stored in the racks by the entrance.
chinese: 可將鞋履放在入口旁的鞋架上。進入更衣走廊須穿上鞋套。

english: Attach the white tag to the new clothesline. The old line can be taken to the estate recycling point.
chinese: 舊晾衣繩可送往屋苑回收點。請在新晾衣繩掛上藍色標籤。

english: Each pupil may check out up to two dictionaries at once. Some dictionaries come with a pronunciation guide.
chinese: 部分字典附有發音指南。每名學生同時最多可借用兩本字典。

english: Photograph the retaining wall from the footpath below it. The photographic record is attached to the maintenance report.
chinese: 請從擋土牆上方的行人徑拍攝牆身。相片紀錄將附於保養報告。

english: Students may use their preferred first name in the yearbook. Use the spelling you want printed.
chinese: 請填寫你希望印在紀念冊上的拼法。學生可在畢業紀念冊使用自己選用的名字。

english: Record the microchip number shown by the scanner. The receipt lists the date of examination.
chinese: 收據列有檢查日期。請記錄由動物主人報稱的晶片號碼。

english: The clearance certificate remains valid for six months after issue. An inspector can explain the next steps to the tenant.
chinese: 合格證明書自簽發日起六個月內有效。檢查人員可向租戶解釋後續程序。

english: The checkout log tracks which magnification is in use. If the storage sleeve feels damp, replace the sleeve before putting the objective away. Remove the objective without touching the glass.
chinese: 借用紀錄列明正在使用的放大倍率。如收納套摸起來潮濕，須先更換收納套，再存放物鏡。取出物鏡時請勿觸碰鏡片。

english: Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink. Place it where it can be read without moving the stored items.
chinese: 指示卡應置於毋須移動存放物品便可查看的位置。濕度指示卡有三格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。

english: If a caller disputes the transcript, retain the caller's written correction alongside the original. Record the date on which the original transcript was shared.
chinese: 如來電者對通話文字記錄有異議，須將來電者提交的書面更正與原文一併保存。請記錄發出原有文字記錄的日期。

english: Visitors may take handwritten notes during inspection. Show the inspection booking confirmation on arrival.
chinese: 抵達後請出示查閱預約確認。查閱登記冊時，訪客可拍攝資料。

english: The screening includes audio description. The doors will open before the introduction.
chinese: 放映場次設有口述影像服務。入場門會在開場介紹前開放。

english: You can transfer your repair appointment to another household member. Use the side door to reach the waiting area.
chinese: 維修預約不可轉讓給同住的其他家庭成員。請經側門前往等候區。

english: The interpreter must be at least 18 years old. The interpreter should arrive with the parties.
chinese: 傳譯員應與各方一同到場。傳譯員須年滿21歲。

english: Report missing labels to the equipment librarian. Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth.
chinese: 如有標籤遺失，請通知器材管理員。請用乾棉布清潔凸字標籤。

english: The briefing recording may be released with the speaker's consent. The recording covers the question period.
chinese: 錄音涵蓋答問環節。取得場地營辦商同意後，方可公開簡報錄音。

english: Blue vouchers allow collection from a later swap and yellow vouchers give credit for next year's event. Keep any redeemed voucher number for your records. A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed.
chinese: 請自行保存已兌換的券號。藍色券可用於較後一場交換活動領取服裝，黃色券則可用作下年度活動的抵用額。取消領取後，仍可使用藍色券所列的選項，但如補發券已獲兌換，則不在此限。

english: The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front. Delete test scans when the check is complete. When checking the repaired scanner, use the first profile in the test guide for the test scan.
chinese: 第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面，第二個則只掃描正面。完成檢查後須刪除測試掃描檔案。檢查已維修的掃描器時，請採用測試指引所載的第一個設定檔進行測試掃描。

english: Shoes with black soles are prohibited on the tryout courts. Racquets can be borrowed from the sports office.
chinese: 選拔試場地禁止穿着黑底鞋。體育組辦事處備有球拍供借用。

english: The caption may identify the species. Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates are still attached. Original files remain in the restricted research folder.
chinese: 只有在刪除坐標後，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。原始檔案會保留在限制存取的研究資料夾。相片說明可註明物種。

english: Suitable cups are available for participants who need easy-grip handles. Write your table number on the drink slip before taking it to the counter.
chinese: 將飲品單交到櫃檯前，請先填上桌號。如需容易握持的杯柄，可索取合適的杯。

english: Notify the learning support coordinator if you cannot attend your appointment. An appointment can be booked without a referral.
chinese: 學生毋須轉介即可預約。如未能出席預約時段，請通知學習支援統籌主任。

english: State whether the nutrition figures are for the product as sold or as prepared. Display the ingredient list next to the nutrition panel.
chinese: 成分表須列於營養標籤旁。

english: The canteen may record the case without immediately changing the balance. If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds. The account shows the sequence of transfers.
chinese: 飯堂可先登記事件，毋須即時調整結餘。如膳食積分已轉移兩次，須只撤銷首次轉移，在付款服務商回覆前不得處理第二次轉移。帳戶會顯示各次轉移的先後次序。

english: Set the keyboard to the acoustic piano sound for the practical assessment. Candidates may bring their own sheet music.
chinese: 應考學生可自備樂譜。實習評核須把電子琴設定為電鋼琴音色。

english: Flatten empty cartons before placing them in the collection cage. Remove loose tape from the collection area.
chinese: 請清走收集區內的散落膠紙。空紙箱放入回收籠前，須先壓平。

english: Use the shared folder to file the rehearsal notes. Revise the cue sheet after the stage manager confirms receipt of the marked script. The booth keeps a printed working copy.
chinese: 彩排紀錄須存入共用資料夾。舞台監督確認收到附有標記的劇本後，才可修改場務提示表。控制室備有供工作使用的紙本。

english: Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink. Place it where it can be read without moving the stored items.
chinese: 指示卡應置於毋須移動存放物品便可查看的位置。濕度指示卡有兩格變成粉紅色時，請更換指示卡。

english: The receipt lists the date of examination. Record the microchip number shown by the scanner.
chinese: 請記錄晶片掃描器所顯示的號碼。收據列有檢查日期。

english: The grounds team will inspect seed growth each week. The lawn can reopen after seeding, except in the marked section beside the shelter. The shelter itself remains available.
chinese: 園務小組會每周檢查種子生長情況。草地完成播種後可重開，但涼亭旁有標記的部分除外。涼亭照常開放。

english: The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days. Members can try the samples on the practice loom.
chinese: 紗線樣本可免費借用十天。會員可在練習用織機試用樣本。

english: Notify the attendance secretary if you cannot attend your appointment. An appointment can be booked without a referral.
chinese: 學生毋須轉介即可預約。如未能出席預約時段，請通知學習支援統籌主任。

english: Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed. Original files remain in the restricted research folder. Club members can flag duplicate images for the editor.
chinese: 原始檔案會保留在限制存取的研究資料夾。學會會員可標記重複相片，供編輯處理。只有在保留坐標的情況下，調查相片才可放入公開相簿。

english: The case reference appears at the top of each record. If a caller disputes the transcript, retain the caller's written correction alongside the original.
chinese: 如來電者對通話文字記錄有異議，須將來電者提交的書面更正與原文一併保存。每份紀錄的頂部均載有個案編號。

english: The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group. Speakers may suggest amendments to the edited text.
chinese: 故事分享小組保留錄音只供內部謄寫，並會向小組成員分享經編輯的文字稿。講述者可就文字稿提出修訂建議。

english: Push the latch inward to lower the trolley handle. The handle locks into place at its lowest setting.
chinese: 手柄調至最低位置時會鎖定。向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。
